metadata.name: stremio-web
metadata.description: Stremio - Freedom to Stream

summary.zh: Stremio官方Web端是基于React与WebAssembly架构的流媒体娱乐客户端，依托Rust编译的WASM核心引擎实现插件扩展、跨端同步、投屏播放等能力，支持安装为PWA，为用户提供一站式视频内容聚合与播放服务。
summary.en: Stremio Web is the official web client of the streaming entertainment platform, built with React and WebAssembly. It leverages a Rust-compiled WASM core engine to support addon extensions, cross-device sync, casting and more, can be installed as a PWA, providing one-stop video content aggregation and playback services.

metadata.name: clash-verge-rev
metadata.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience

summary.zh: Clash Verge Rev 是原 Clash Verge 的延续项目，基于 Tauri 2 与 Rust 开发，为 Windows、macOS、Linux 三大桌面系统提供 Clash Meta 代理 GUI 客户端，内置 mihomo 内核，支持代理配置管理、TUN 模式、主题自定义、WebDav 配置同步等功能，满足用户跨平台代理使用需求。
summary.en: Clash Verge Rev is a continuation of the original Clash Verge project, a cross-platform Clash Meta proxy GUI client built with Tauri 2 and Rust. It supports Windows, macOS and Linux, integrates the mihomo core, and provides features like proxy configuration management, TUN mode, custom themes, and WebDav config sync to meet users' cross-platform proxy needs.
tags_zh: 跨平台桌面代理客户端

metadata.name: czkawka
metadata.description: Multi functional app to find duplicates, empty folders, similar images etc.

summary.zh: Rust开发的开源跨平台文件清理工具，核心库可复用，提供CLI、桌面GUI（Krokiet替代旧版GTK4版Czkawka）、Android端多前端，支持重复文件查找、空文件夹清理、相似媒体识别、坏文件检测等14+功能，多线程高效、内存安全、无广告，适配全架构。
summary.en: An open-source, cross-platform file cleanup tool built with Rust, featuring a reusable core library. It provides multiple frontends: CLI, desktop GUI (Krokiet, the successor of the legacy GTK4-based Czkawka) and Android app. It supports 14+ functions including duplicate file detection, empty folder cleanup, similar media recognition and corrupted file check, with multithreaded high efficiency, memory safety and no ads, compatible with all architectures.

metadata.name: JAVBUS
metadata.description: 一个插件式BT种子搜索器，通过为BHT爬虫网站、BT资源收集网站制作html正则匹配json插件，来实现一个软件-全网资源的效果。同时支持网盘搜索、局域网互传

summary.zh: JAVBUS 是基于 Flutter 开发的插件式资源搜索工具，通过轻量声明式 JSON 插件对接各类 BT、网盘资源站，无需编程即可创建插件，同时集成收藏管理、局域网文件/文本互传功能，支持全平台运行，移动端体验友好。
summary.en: JAVBUS is a Flutter-based plugin-driven resource search tool that connects to various BT and cloud storage resource sites via lightweight declarative JSON plugins, enabling plugin creation without any programming. It also integrates favorites management and LAN file/text transfer, supports cross-platform operation and offers mobile-friendly experience.

metadata.name: gitpush
metadata.description: an AI Github Rlease Tracker Powered by Cloudflare

summary.zh: GitPush是基于Cloudflare生态的AI驱动GitHub Release追踪工具，可自动监控指定仓库的版本更新，借助DeepSeek R1生成更新摘要，通过邮件推送通知，支持定时巡检与手动触发，提供免部署云版本与自部署方案，降低开发者追踪开源项目更新的成本。
summary.en: GitPush is an AI-powered GitHub Release Tracker built on Cloudflare ecosystem. It automatically monitors version updates of specified repositories, generates update summaries via DeepSeek R1, and pushes notifications via email. It supports scheduled inspection and manual triggering, offering both a no-deployment cloud version and a self-deployment solution, reducing the cost for developers to track open source project updates.

metadata.name: x-ui-pro
metadata.description: XUI-PRO nginx reverse proxy with ws/grpc/httpupgrade/splithttp,xray protocol support: vless,vmess,trojan,shadowsocks panel cloudflare ssl,xtls,ssr,v2fly,v2ray installer bypass restrictions sing-box,shadowtls,reality,tunnel,gfw tor warp wireguard geoip tuic clash vpn mihomo psiphon hy2 oneclick argo bbr wstunnel anticensorship⚡🛡️

summary.zh: x-ui-pro是面向Linux服务器的开源一键部署代理服务集成方案，整合x-ui面板、v2rayA、WARP、Tor、Psiphon与nginx，支持VLESS/VMess/Trojan等主流代理协议，具备Cloudflare CDN适配、自动SSL续期、反检测伪装、多域名统一管理能力，用于网络访问限制绕过。
summary.en: XUI-PRO is an open-source one-click deployment integrated proxy solution for Linux servers, combining x-ui panel, v2rayA, WARP, Tor, Psiphon and nginx. It supports mainstream proxy protocols including VLESS, VMess and Trojan, with features like Cloudflare CDN adaptation, auto SSL renewal, anti-detection camouflage and multi-domain management, for bypassing internet access restrictions.

metadata.name: ai-coding-welfare
metadata.description: AI Coding 福利站导航：免费白嫖 Claude Code / Codex 的中转站与公益站合集，含额度、模型、价格自动更新与一键配置脚本

summary.zh: AI Coding福利站导航，聚合Claude Code、Codex等AI编程工具的免费中转/公益站，自动更新站点额度、模型、价格与在线状态，提供一键配置脚本，帮助用户零成本获取大模型编程工具使用额度。
summary.en: AI Coding Welfare Navigation aggregates free relay and public welfare stations for AI programming tools such as Claude Code and Codex, automatically updates station quotas, supported models, pricing and online status, provides one-click configuration scripts, enabling users to access large-model programming tools at zero cost.

metadata.name: xiaozhi-esp32
metadata.description: An MCP-based chatbot | 一个基于MCP的聊天机器人

summary.zh: 本项目是基于MCP协议的ESP32嵌入式智能聊天机器人，集成Qwen、DeepSeek等大模型能力，支持离线语音唤醒、全双工交互、视觉输入，通过设备端与云端MCP实现硬件控制与能力扩展，适配138+款ESP32开发板，适用于智能硬件DIY及物联网交互场景。
summary.en: This project is an MCP-based ESP32 embedded intelligent chatbot, which integrates capabilities of large models like Qwen and DeepSeek. It supports offline voice wake-up, full-duplex interaction and visual input, realizes hardware control and capability expansion via device-side and cloud-side MCP, adapts to 138+ ESP32 development boards, and is suitable for smart hardware DIY and IoT interaction scenarios.

metadata.name: lx-lxwalnut-music-mobile
metadata.description: 基于lx-netease-music-mobile改版，满足个人需求，仅个人自用！！！

summary.zh: 本仓库是基于React Native开发的移动端音乐播放器改版项目，在开源三方版本基础上适配个人需求，聚合多平台音源，支持自定义主题、逐字歌词、小爱联动、WebDAV同步、横屏适配等功能，实现个性化听歌体验。
summary.en: This repository is a modified mobile music player app built with React Native, forked from an open-source third-party version for personal use. It aggregates multi-platform audio sources, and supports custom themes, word-by-word lyrics, Xiaoai linkage, WebDAV sync, landscape adaptation and more, delivering a personalized music listening experience.

metadata.name: lx-music-xinghai-source
metadata.description: 星海音乐源 | LX Music 自定义音源插件，聚合 GDAPI/ChKSz API，支持酷我加密音频解密（需自行配置）

summary.zh: 星海音乐源是LX Music自定义音源插件，聚合GDAPI、ChKSz等公开第三方接口，支持网易云、QQ、酷我、酷狗、咪咕五大主流平台多音质音乐获取，可配合中转服务器实现酷我加密音频实时解密，仅供个人学习与交流使用。
summary.en: Xinghai Music Source is a custom audio source plugin for LX Music, aggregating public third-party APIs such as GDAPI and ChKSz, supporting multi-bitrate music acquisition from 5 mainstream platforms including NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Kuwo Music, Kugou Music and Migu Music, and capable of real-time decryption of Kuwo encrypted audio with a relay server, for personal learning and communication only.

metadata.name: lx-music-server
metadata.description: 运行在 Hono.js 上的 LX Music 数据同步服务，支持Cloudflare Worker部署

summary.zh: 本仓库是LX Music桌面端数据同步服务的Cloudflare Workers重构版，基于Hono.js与Durable Objects构建，无需自托管服务器即可实现多用户隔离、WebSocket实时双向同步歌单与用户偏好，支持快照合并冲突处理，可一键部署至Cloudflare平台。
summary.en: This repository is a Cloudflare Workers-based rebuild of the LX Music desktop data sync service, built with Hono.js and Durable Objects. It eliminates the need for self-hosted servers, offering multi-user isolation, WebSocket real-time bidirectional sync of playlists and user preferences, snapshot merging for conflict resolution, and one-click deployment to Cloudflare.

metadata.name: LinkSwift
metadata.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘

summary.zh: 基于JavaScript开发的网盘直链提取工具，由「网盘直链下载助手」修改而来，支持百度网盘、阿里云盘等8大主流网盘，可绕过平台下载限速，提升资源获取效率，属于浏览器脚本类实用工具。
summary.en: A JavaScript-based direct link extraction tool for cloud storage services, modified from the 'Cloud Storage Direct Link Download Assistant', supporting 8 mainstream platforms including Baidu Netdisk and Alibaba Cloud Disk. It bypasses platform download speed limits to improve resource acquisition efficiency, and is a practical browser script tool.

metadata.name: MyIP
metadata.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.

summary.zh: 开源可自托管的全能IP工具箱，覆盖IP多源查询、WebRTC/DNS泄露检测、网络测速、MTR路由追踪、网站可用性校验等全链路网络诊断能力，支持Docker一键部署、PWA及多语言，适用于个人隐私检测、网络运维、代理规则校验等场景。
summary.en: An open-source, self-hostable all-in-one IP toolbox providing full-chain network diagnostics including multi-source IP lookup, WebRTC/DNS leak detection, speed test, MTR route tracing, and website availability checks. It supports one-click Docker deployment, PWA, and multi-language, suitable for personal privacy detection, network operation and maintenance, and proxy rule verification.

metadata.name: openwrt-clashoo
metadata.description: 基于 mihomo 和 sing-box 的简单、稳定、开箱即用的 LuCI 代理应用

summary.zh: 面向OpenWrt 24.10+系统的LuCI双内核代理应用，基于mihomo与sing-box，主打简单稳定、开箱即用，支持内核无缝切换、配置自动校验、DNS与透明代理精细化管控，大幅降低路由器代理配置门槛。
summary.en: A LuCI dual-kernel proxy application for OpenWrt 24.10+ systems, built on mihomo and sing-box, featuring simplicity, stability and out-of-the-box usability. It supports seamless kernel switching, automatic configuration validation, and fine-grained control over DNS and transparent proxy, greatly lowering the threshold for router proxy configuration.

metadata.name: FluxDown
metadata.description: Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，智能多线程加速与浏览器无缝集成。精美界面，极致性能，永久免费，零广告。

summary.zh: FluxDown是基于Rust+Flutter开发的开源多协议下载管理器，支持HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent、HLS/DASH等协议，具备智能多线程加速、浏览器集成、MCP服务器能力，覆盖Windows/macOS/Linux/移动端等多平台，永久免费无广告，是IDM的高性能替代方案。
summary.en: FluxDown is an open-source multi-protocol download manager built with Rust and Flutter. It supports HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent, HLS/DASH streaming and more, featuring intelligent multi-threaded acceleration, browser integration, and a built-in MCP server. It runs on Windows, macOS, Linux and mobile platforms, is completely free, ad-free and privacy-focused, and serves as a high-performance alternative to IDM.

metadata.name: fapiao-print
metadata.description: 发票酱 - 发票批量打印工具，轻量桌面应用+WEB模式，支持 PDF、OFD、XML、图片等多格式，一键识别发票数据，快速排版、打印、重命名或导出

summary.zh: 发票酱是基于Tauri开发的Windows轻量发票批量打印工具，支持PDF、OFD、XML、图片等多格式导入，集成PP-OCRv6智能识别，提供智能排版、批量打印、重命名及导出功能，单文件exe即开即用，适配办公报销场景。
summary.en: Fapiao Print is a lightweight Windows desktop invoice batch printing tool built with Tauri. It supports importing invoices in multiple formats including PDF, OFD, XML and images, integrates PP-OCRv6 for intelligent data extraction, and provides smart layout, batch printing, renaming and export functions. Packaged as a single exe file for out-of-the-box use, it is ideal for office reimbursement scenarios.

metadata.name: Median
metadata.description: 一个功能密度极高的，安装包仅200kb的极致轻量化浏览器

summary.zh: Median是一款极致轻量化的Android本地优先隐私浏览器，安装包仅200KB，基于系统WebView以原生Java开发，无广告SDK与数据收集，内置广告拦截、本地加密密码库、用户脚本、离线阅读等功能，适配注重隐私与轻量体验的Android用户。
summary.en: Median is an extremely lightweight local-first privacy browser for Android, with a mere 200KB installation package. Built on Android System WebView using native Java, it has no ad SDKs or data collection mechanisms, and integrates features like ad blocking, local encrypted password vault, user scripts and offline reading, serving Android users who prioritize privacy and lightweight experience.

metadata.name: hsck
metadata.description: hsck json

summary.zh: 海阔小程序离线视频数据源采集工具，基于Python开发，可自动采集视频数据并生成JSON/TXT/M3U格式离线源文件，支持媒体缓存、微信推送通知，可配置GitHub Actions定时执行，内置滑块验证解决等采集能力，适用于视频源离线备份与公开分发场景。
summary.en: An offline video data source collection tool for Haikuo mini-programs, built with Python. It automatically collects video data and generates offline source files in JSON/TXT/M3U formats, supports media caching and WeChat push notifications, can be scheduled via GitHub Actions, and includes built-in capabilities like slider captcha solving for collection, suitable for offline backup and public distribution of video sources.

summary.zh: 暂无描述。

metadata.name: otter-music
metadata.description: 基于 React + Capacitor 的免费音乐 App，支持多音源搜索、网易云登录、主流平台歌单导入，以及 B 站音源搜索播放，安装包仅 2.5 MB。基于 GD Studio's Online Music Platform API。

summary.zh: 基于React+Capacitor开发的免费多音源聚合音乐播放器，聚合网易云、B站、QQ音乐等主流音源，支持多平台歌单导入、播放失败自动回退换源，安装包仅2.5MB，支持PWA与安卓端部署，提供播放、下载、WebDAV数据同步等完整功能。
summary.en: A free multi-source aggregated music player built with React and Capacitor, integrating mainstream music sources such as NetEase Cloud Music, Bilibili and QQ Music. It supports cross-platform playlist import, automatic source fallback when playback fails, comes with a lightweight 2.5MB installation package, provides PWA and Android deployment, and offers full features including playback, download and WebDAV data sync.
tags_zh: 多音源聚合音乐播放器

metadata.name: OmniRoute
metadata.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 352 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 550+ contributors

summary.zh: OmniRoute是MIT协议的免费AI网关，统一端点聚合352+AI服务商（含150+免费套餐）、1200+模型，兼容Cursor、Copilot等主流AI编程工具，支持配额感知自动降级、RTK+Caveman token压缩（最高省95%），同时支持MCP/A2A协议与桌面/PWA形态，由550+贡献者共建。
summary.en: OmniRoute is a free, MIT-licensed AI gateway that aggregates 352+ AI providers (including 150+ free-tier options) and 1200+ models via a single endpoint. It works with mainstream AI coding tools like Cursor and Copilot, features quota-aware auto-fallback and RTK+Caveman token compression (saving up to 95% tokens), supports MCP/A2A protocols and desktop/PWA deployment, and is built by 550+ contributors.

metadata.name: qiying-media-vault
metadata.description: Local-first media vault with static indexing, HLS playback, Cloudflare Workers, and GitHub Pages deployment.

summary.zh: 栖影（Qiying Media Vault）是面向大规模图片与HLS视频的本地优先静态媒体浏览站点，支持帖子检索、瀑布流浏览、沉浸式视频播放与媒体预览，采用数据分片按需加载策略，可部署至Cloudflare Workers或GitHub Pages，内置媒体代理解决跨域播放问题。
summary.en: Qiying Media Vault is a local-first static media browsing site designed for large-scale image and HLS video data. It supports post search, waterfall browsing, immersive video playback and media preview, adopts sharded data on-demand loading strategy, can be deployed to Cloudflare Workers or GitHub Pages, and features a built-in media proxy to solve cross-domain playback issues.

metadata.name: CoShell
metadata.description: 一款集成 AI 助手的轻量级 SSH 终端桌面应用。

summary.zh: CoShell是本地优先的Windows桌面SSH/SFTP工作台，集成AI运维助手，支持多标签终端、文件管理、在线编辑、内置聚合搜索，采用AES-GCM等加密机制保障数据安全，面向个人及可信内网场景，无需额外依赖即可快速部署。
summary.en: CoShell is a local-first Windows desktop SSH/SFTP workstation with an integrated AI operations assistant. It supports multi-tab terminals, file management, online editing, and built-in aggregated search, uses AES-GCM encryption for data security, and is designed for personal and trusted intranet scenarios with no extra dependencies needed for deployment.

metadata.name: cf-manager
metadata.description: An all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare. Manage Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference & browser rendering visually, with an OpenAI-compatible API for external integration.

summary.zh: CF Manager 是面向开发者与运维人员的自托管 Cloudflare 多账号统一管理面板，可可视化管控 DNS、Workers、KV/D1/R2 存储、AI 推理及浏览器渲染能力，内置本地 OpenAI 兼容接口，解决多账号频繁切换、批量资源操作繁琐的痛点，全链路数据本地可控。
summary.en: CF Manager is a self-hosted unified management dashboard for multiple Cloudflare accounts, designed for developers and operators. It supports visual management of DNS, Workers, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference and browser rendering, and provides a built-in local OpenAI-compatible interface, solving the pain points of frequent account switching and tedious bulk resource operations with full local data control.

metadata.name: C-SSH
metadata.description: Native cross-platform SSH ops: Windows/Android stable + macOS v0.8.8 test build. 原生跨平台 SSH 运维 · Windows/Android 正式版 + macOS 测试版

summary.zh: C-SSH是原生跨平台SSH运维客户端，提供Windows/Android稳定版与macOS测试版，支持持久化终端、文件管理、AI助手等核心能力，采用Agent与原生SSH双主机模式，适配桌面及移动端运维场景，保障凭据与数据安全。
summary.en: Creation-SSH (C-SSH) is a native cross-platform SSH operations client with stable Windows/Android releases and a macOS test build. It offers core features like persistent terminals, file management, and AI assistant, supports dual host modes (Agent & native SSH) for desktop and mobile O&M scenarios, and ensures credential and data security.

metadata.name: awesome-zhuiju-free
metadata.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。

summary.zh: 本仓库为免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选在线影视、网盘搜索、磁力BT、IPTV直播源、TVBox配置等114类资源，每日自动检测资源可用性，完全开源由社区共同维护，为追剧用户提供纯净高效的资源索引服务。
summary.en: This repository is a free, ad-free drama watching resource guide, manually curating 114 types of resources including online streaming, cloud storage search, magnet/BT, IPTV live sources, and TVBox configurations. It automatically checks resource availability daily, is fully open source and maintained by the community, providing pure and efficient resource indexing for drama viewers.

metadata.name: pentagi
metadata.description: Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks

summary.zh: PentAGI是全自主AI渗透测试系统，面向信息安全专业人员与研究者，依托AI自主决策执行渗透测试全流程，支持执行监控与智能任务规划，内置20余款专业安全工具，采用Docker沙箱隔离，支持多LLM接入、知识图谱集成与长期记忆，可自动化完成复杂渗透测试任务，提升安全测试效率与灵活性。
summary.en: PentAGI is a fully autonomous AI penetration testing system designed for authorized security assessment scenarios, serving information security professionals and researchers. It leverages AI agents and large models to autonomously plan and execute full penetration testing workflows with optional execution monitoring and intelligent task planning, integrates over 20 professional security tools, adopts Docker sandbox isolation, supports multi-LLM access and knowledge graph integration with long-term memory, and automates complex penetration testing tasks to significantly improve security testing efficiency and flexibility.

metadata.name: MoonTVPlus
metadata.description: MoonTVPlus 是基于 MoonTV v100 二次开发的增强版影视聚合播放器。它在原版基础上新增了外部播放器支持、视频超分、弹幕系统、评论抓取等实用功能，提供更强大的观影体验。

summary.zh: MoonTVPlus是基于MoonTV v100二次开发的增强版影视聚合播放器，新增外部播放器支持、WebGPU视频超分、弹幕系统、豆瓣评论抓取、多人观影室等功能，采用Next.js+Tailwind+TypeScript技术栈，支持多平台一键部署，提供更强大的个性化观影体验。
summary.en: MoonTVPlus is an enhanced video aggregation player forked from MoonTV v100, integrating features like external player support, WebGPU-based video upscaling, danmaku system, Douban comment scraping, and synchronized watch party. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and TypeScript, it supports one-click deployment across multiple platforms to deliver a superior personalized viewing experience.

metadata.name: NetQuality
metadata.description: 网络质量检测脚本 - Network Quality Check Script

summary.zh: 本脚本为跨平台网络质量检测工具，支持主流Linux发行版、macOS及Docker运行的Windows系统，覆盖IPv4/IPv6双栈检测，集成BGP信息、三网延迟、回程路由、国内外测速等七大模块，支持JSON输出与多模式灵活检测，便于网络质量排查与结果分享。
summary.en: This is a cross-platform network quality detection tool that supports mainstream Linux distributions, macOS, and Windows systems via Docker. It covers IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack detection, integrates seven modules including BGP information, three-network latency, return route, and domestic/international speed tests, supports JSON output and flexible multi-mode detection, facilitating network quality troubleshooting and result sharing.

metadata.name: ziyuanzhan
metadata.description: 资源站,影视资源站与采集站聚集和收集平台。实时监控全网主流影视类、视频类采集联盟的播放源、视频源接口可用性支持libretv，moontvplus，maccms等

summary.zh: 零成本影视资源站实时监测工具，基于GitHub Actions定时调用第三方API完成资源站可用性健康检查，自动生成静态可视化面板与多维度JSON数据，支持AI Agent直接调用，无需服务器与运行时，服务于影视采集站运维与资源检索场景。
summary.en: A zero-cost real-time monitoring tool for film and television resource sites. It uses GitHub Actions to periodically call third-party APIs for availability health checks of collection sites, automatically generates static visualization dashboards and multi-dimensional JSON data, supports direct AI Agent calls, requires no servers or runtime, serving operations of video collection platforms and resource retrieval scenarios.

metadata.name: mcp-vods
metadata.description: 📺 MCP Server for Binge-watch / MoonTV / LunaTV. 一个用于追剧/追番的MCP服务器，为AI提供搜索影视播放地址的能力，并支持在小米电视上直接播放

summary.zh: 本MCP服务器为AI工具提供影视搜索与播放地址获取能力，支持对接小米电视等智能设备直接投屏播放，提供uvx、Docker、Home Assistant插件等多方式部署，内置LunaTV/MoonTV订阅源开箱即用，适配Claude Code、Cursor等主流AI开发工具。
summary.en: This MCP server provides AI tools with video search and playback address capabilities, supports direct screen casting to Xiaomi TVs and other smart devices, offers multiple deployment methods including uvx, Docker and Home Assistant add-on, comes with built-in LunaTV/MoonTV subscription sources for out-of-the-box use, and is compatible with mainstream AI development tools like Claude Code and Cursor.

metadata.name: LunaTV-config
metadata.description: MoonTV/LunaTV源配置，每日自动检测API状态，可在CF部署CORSAPI中转被墙API，本人提供的CORSAPI仅为测试使用，请勿滥用！

summary.zh: 本项目为LunaTV/MoonTV流媒体应用提供源配置及配套CORSAPI中转服务，基于Cloudflare Workers部署，支持多版本影视源配置、Base58编码订阅生成，可解决被墙API访问问题，每日自动检测源可用性，配套在线配置编辑器。
summary.en: This repository provides source configurations for LunaTV/MoonTV streaming apps and a supporting CORSAPI proxy service. Built on Cloudflare Workers, it supports multi-version media source configs, Base58 encoded subscription generation, resolves blocked API access issues, performs daily source availability checks, and comes with an online config editor.

metadata.name: sublinkPro
metadata.description: ✨ 现代化代理订阅管理平台 | 智能分类 · 专业测速 · 链式中转 · 流量监控 · TG管理 · JS扩展 | Go+React 全新UI 🌍 Modern Proxy Subscription Manager | Smart Tags · Speed Test · Relays · Monitor · TG Bot · JS Scripts

summary.zh: SublinkPro是基于sublinkX、sublinkE重构的现代化代理订阅管理与转换平台，采用Go+React前后端分离架构，支持智能标签分类、节点专业测速、链式中转、流量监控、TG机器人管理及JS脚本扩展，提供Docker一键部署，适用于代理订阅自动化管理、节点筛选与流量管控场景。
summary.en: SublinkPro is a modern proxy subscription management and conversion platform refactored from open-source projects sublinkX and sublinkE. Built with Go + React full-stack architecture, it offers smart tag classification, professional node speed testing, relay chaining, traffic monitoring, Telegram bot management and JS script extension, with Docker one-click deployment for automated proxy subscription management, node filtering and traffic control scenarios.

metadata.name: videoduplicatefinder
metadata.description: Video Duplicate Finder - Crossplatform

summary.zh: Video Duplicate Finder 是跨平台重复媒体查找工具，可识别不同分辨率、帧率、带水印的重复视频与图片，支持音频指纹检测部分片段、可选本地AI匹配识别裁剪/镜像等编辑副本，提供桌面GUI、CLI、WebUI及Docker镜像，适配本地存储、NAS、自动化脚本等场景。
summary.en: Video Duplicate Finder is a cross-platform duplicate media detection tool that identifies duplicate videos and images with different resolutions, frame rates or watermarks. It supports audio fingerprinting for partial clip detection and optional local AI matching to recognize edited copies like cropped or mirrored ones. It provides desktop GUI, CLI, Web UI and Docker image for local storage, NAS and automation scenarios.

metadata.name: Collect-IPTV
metadata.description: 📡IPTV节目源收集，每4小时更新！！

summary.zh: 本项目为IPTV直播源自动聚合工具，基于AI辅助优化爬虫采集公开直播源，依托GitHub服务器做可用性与延迟测试，支持去重与低延迟源优选，每4小时自动生成更新M3U/M3U8播放列表，配套网页端展示台标，不保证国内网络可用性，仅供个人学习测试使用。
summary.en: This project is an IPTV live source auto-aggregation tool that uses AI-optimized crawlers to collect public live sources. It leverages GitHub servers for availability and latency testing, supports deduplication and low-latency source optimization, automatically generates and updates M3U/M3U8 playlists every 4 hours, and provides a web interface with channel logos. It is for personal learning and testing only, with no guarantee of accessibility in Chinese networks.

summary.zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers、D1数据库与R2对象存储构建的零服务器成本轻量博客系统，支持MCP Server对接AI Agent，具备安全加固、多级缓存优化、SEO适配、后台内容管理、RSS订阅等能力，可快速部署个人轻量内容站点。
summary.en: A zero-server-cost lightweight blog system built on Cloudflare Workers, D1 and R2, supporting MCP Server integration for AI agents. It features security hardening, multi-level cache optimization, SEO adaptation, backend content management and RSS subscription, enabling fast deployment of personal lightweight content sites.
tags_zh: 个人博客部署与AI Agent对接
tags_en: AI Agent Integration & Personal Blog Deployment

metadata.name: sms_forwarding
metadata.description: 超低成本硬件短信转发器，支持移动联通电信，ML307R+ESP32C3

summary.zh: 本项目为超低成本短信转发硬件方案，基于ESP32C3与ML307R 4G模块搭建，总成本约27.8元，支持移动/联通/电信卡，无需修改模块固件，采用Arduino开发，支持多渠道短信自动转发、Web可视化管理、长短信合并、余额消耗等功能，适用于手机卡保号、低成本短信通知接收场景。
summary.en: This project is an ultra-low-cost SMS forwarding hardware solution built with ESP32C3 and ML307R 4G module, with a total cost of about 27.8 yuan. It supports SIM cards from China Mobile, China Unicom and China Telecom, requires no modification of the module firmware, and is developed with Arduino. It supports multi-channel SMS auto-forwarding, Web visual management, long SMS merging, balance consumption and other functions, suitable for SIM card retention and low-cost SMS notification reception.

metadata.name: Selene-TV
metadata.description: 以 MoonTV v100 版本 / Helios 为后端的 Android TV 客户端，针对遥控器设备优化

summary.zh: Selene-TV 是专为 Android TV 大屏设计的流媒体客户端，以 MoonTV/Helios 为后端，基于 Kotlin + Jetpack Compose for TV 开发，针对遥控器 D-pad 操作深度优化，支持 ExoPlayer/mpv 双播放内核、多源聚合测速、跨平台弹幕聚合、手机扫码遥控，适配 1080p 至 4K 大屏场景。
summary.en: Selene-TV is an Android TV streaming client built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for TV, optimized exclusively for D-pad remote control operation. It connects to MoonTV/Helios backends, integrates dual playback kernels (ExoPlayer/mpv), supports multi-source aggregation with speed test, cross-platform danmaku aggregation, and mobile scan-to-remote functionality, tailored for 1080p to 4K large-screen TV scenarios.

metadata.name: GithubStarsIndex
metadata.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。

summary.zh: 该工具可自动抓取GitHub账号的Star仓库，调用AI生成内容摘要与技术标签，通过内置映射库实现标签归一化治理避免爆炸，支持增量更新元数据、并发高效处理，可同步至Obsidian知识库与GitHub Pages静态检索页，解决开发者技术资源归档与检索痛点。
summary.en: This tool automatically fetches all starred repositories from a user's GitHub account, leverages compatible OpenAI-format AI interfaces to generate content summaries and standardized technical tags, normalizes tags via a built-in mapping library to avoid tag explosion, supports incremental metadata updates and concurrent high-efficiency processing for large star lists, can be scheduled to run via GitHub Actions, and syncs results to Obsidian knowledge base and GitHub Pages static search pages, effectively solving developers' pain points in technical resource archiving, classification and retrieval.

metadata.description: nine one

summary.zh: 91是面向个人部署的私有视频站，支持115、PikPak、OneDrive等十余种网盘接入，具备302低带宽播放、抖音风短视频模式、一次性分享、自定义爬虫脚本导入等功能，提供一键脚本与Docker Compose两种部署方式，适配个人影音资源管理场景。
summary.en: 91 is a privately deployable personal video station supporting integration of over 10 cloud storage services such as 115, PikPak, OneDrive and Google Drive. It offers 302 low-bandwidth playback, TikTok-style short video mode, one-time shareable links, custom crawler script import, and provides one-click script and Docker Compose deployment options for personal media resource management.

summary.zh: 3x-ui二次开发分支，是基于Xray-core的网页式代理协议控制面板，面向个人VPN/代理服务搭建场景优化，新增一键协议模板、中转分流、多服务器下发、批量管理、扫码导入及中文化等功能，支持全自动一键安装，大幅降低代理服务搭建与管理门槛。
summary.en: This is a forked branch of 3x-ui, a web-based Xray-core control panel for configuring and monitoring VPN and proxy protocols. Optimized for personal proxy service deployment scenarios, it adds features including one-click protocol templates, relay traffic splitting, multi-server deployment, batch management, QR code import and Chinese localization, and supports fully automated one-click installation to greatly lower the threshold for proxy service setup and management.

metadata.name: streambert
metadata.description: A cross-platform Electron Desktop App to stream and download any Movie, TV Series or Anime in the World. Zero Ads and Tracking

summary.zh: Streambert是基于Electron开发的跨平台桌面应用，支持全球电影、剧集、动漫的流媒体播放与多线程高速下载，无广告无追踪，内置字幕管理、媒体库追踪、内容发现功能，集成多源元数据接口，支持界面自定义。
summary.en: Streambert is a cross-platform Electron desktop app that supports global streaming and multi-threaded high-speed downloading of movies, TV series and anime, with zero ads and tracking. It offers built-in subtitle management, media library tracking, content discovery, integrates multi-source metadata APIs, and supports interface customization.

metadata.name: vpn-configs-for-russia
metadata.description: 🗽Бесплатные и проверенные VPN конфигурации, работающие в РФ ⚪ Белые списки / обход белых списков ⚪ Free and checked VPN configurations that work in Russia ⚪ Whitelists bypass

summary.zh: 面向俄罗斯用户的免费、实测可用VPN配置合集，用于绕开RKN网络封锁，支持VLESS、Trojan、Shadowsocks等主流代理协议，每2-4小时自动测试过滤失效配置，可导入各类代理客户端，提供多语言说明与镜像备份。
summary.en: A free, rigorously tested VPN configuration collection for users in Russia, designed to bypass Roskomnadzor (RKN) internet censorship. It supports mainstream proxy protocols including VLESS, Trojan and Shadowsocks, with automated availability tests running every 2-4 hours to filter out invalid or low-performance configs. All configs are compatible with most popular proxy clients, and the repository provides multilingual documentation and mirror backups.

summary.zh: X（原推特）媒体批量下载工具，支持批量添加博主账号、一键批量下载图片/视频资源，具备日期范围筛选、文件去重、代理配置、Cookie登录等功能，现由新维护者接手并以AI辅助模式持续迭代，适用于社交媒体内容备份与采集场景。
summary.en: A bulk media downloader for X (formerly Twitter), supporting batch addition of blogger accounts and one-click bulk download of image and video resources. It features date range filtering, file deduplication, proxy configuration and cookie login. Now maintained by a new team with AI-assisted iteration, it is suitable for social media content backup and collection.

metadata.name: XHTTP-Installer
metadata.description: VLESS+XHTTP+TLS Auto-Installer for Ubuntu — Vercel / Netlify relay

summary.zh: 这是一款面向Ubuntu系统的VLESS+XHTTP+TLS代理一键自动部署工具，通过Vercel/Netlify免费CDN作为流量中继隐藏服务器真实IP，集成Let's Encrypt自动SSL签发、Xray核心配置、平台自动部署与故障自愈能力，无需复杂手动操作即可快速搭建高可用代理服务。
summary.en: This is a one-click auto-deployment tool for VLESS+XHTTP+TLS proxy on Ubuntu, leveraging free Vercel/Netlify CDN as traffic relay to conceal the server's real IP. It integrates automatic Let's Encrypt SSL issuance, Xray core configuration, platform auto-deployment and self-healing capabilities, enabling quick setup of high-availability proxy services without complex manual configuration.

metadata.name: lxserver
metadata.description: LX Music 数据同步服务端，同时支持了部分lx-music-desktop的网页端实现。

summary.zh: 本项目是LX Music增强版数据同步服务端，内置现代化网页音乐播放器，支持多平台音乐聚合搜索、歌单同步管理、自动化缓存、歌词卡片分享及Subsonic协议适配，可实现跨设备音乐数据同步，提供流畅的听歌体验。
summary.en: This repository is an enhanced LX Music data synchronization server with a built-in modern web music player. It supports multi-platform music aggregated search, playlist synchronization and management, automated caching, lyric card sharing, and Subsonic protocol compatibility, enabling cross-device music data sync and delivering a smooth listening experience.

summary.zh: 本仓库为体育赛事直播订阅部署工具，基于Cloudflare Workers实现无服务器快速部署，提供TXT/M3U双格式体育赛事直播订阅源，配套安卓端OK壳/极致播放器适配，支持自定义域名绑定，操作简单，适合小白用户便捷获取体育赛事直播内容。
summary.en: This repository is a sports event live streaming subscription deployment tool that supports fast serverless deployment based on Cloudflare Workers. It provides TXT/M3U dual-format sports live streaming subscription sources, with adaptation for Android OK shell/extreme players and custom domain binding support. The simple operation is suitable for novice users to easily access sports live content.

summary.zh: 本项目是开源的高考志愿填报AI决策知识库，还原张雪峰志愿填报核心方法论，覆盖专业选择、志愿策略、新高考选科、大学规划等全流程，核心是决策框架而非单纯分数匹配，可一键部署为AI Agent接入微信、扣子等平台，还纳入AI时代行业前景动态校正，帮助普通家庭弥合志愿填报信息差。
summary.en: This open-source AI decision knowledge base for college application guidance replicates Zhang Xuefeng's core methodology, covering the full process of major selection, application strategy, new Gaokao subject selection and university planning. It focuses on decision frameworks rather than simple score matching, supports one-click deployment as AI Agent for WeChat/Coze platforms, and incorporates dynamic correction of industry prospects in the AI era to bridge information gaps for ordinary families.

metadata.name: zhangxuefeng-skill
metadata.description: 张雪峰.skill — 张雪峰的认知操作系统。高考志愿/考研/职业规划的实战思维框架。由女娲.skill生成。

summary.zh: 本仓库为张雪峰认知操作系统的AI Agent技能，非语录合集，是基于其著作、权威媒体采访等深度调研蒸馏出的可运行思维框架，可模拟张雪峰决策逻辑提供高考志愿、考研、职业规划等实战建议，支持多运行时，面向升学就业决策场景。
summary.en: This repository is an AI Agent skill for Zhang Xuefeng's cognitive operating system. Rather than a collection of quotes, it is a runnable thinking framework distilled from his works, authoritative media interviews and first-hand records. It can simulate Zhang's decision logic to provide practical guidance on college entrance exam application, postgraduate exam and career planning, supports multiple runtimes, and is designed for education and employment decision-making scenarios.

metadata.name: K-Vault
metadata.description: 基于 Cloudflare 的 Serverless 聚合云盘。以 Telegram 为核心（支持 Webhook 直传与 2GB 扩展），并全面兼容 R2、S3、Discord 及 HuggingFace 等多存储后端。零成本构建你的全能私有数据金库。

summary.zh: K-Vault是基于Cloudflare Serverless架构的免费聚合云盘，以Telegram为核心存储后端，兼容R2、S3、Discord等多存储服务，支持Cloudflare Pages与Docker双模部署，提供分片上传、在线预览、WebDAV访问等能力，零成本实现私有数据托管与文件共享。
summary.en: K-Vault is a free serverless aggregated cloud storage based on Cloudflare, using Telegram as the core storage backend, compatible with R2, S3, Discord and other storage services. It supports dual deployment modes of Cloudflare Pages and Docker, offering features like chunked upload, online preview and WebDAV access, enabling zero-cost private data hosting and file sharing.

metadata.name: Telegram_MistRelay
metadata.description: 自动化下载上传

summary.zh: MistRelay 是基于 Telegram 机器人的 aria2 下载控制系统，支持下载完成后通过 rclone 自动上传至 OneDrive，集成文件直链生成、Docker 一键部署、Web 管理界面与多维度数据完整性校验，同时提供独立 Windows 桌面客户端，实现下载、上传、管理的全流程自动化。
summary.en: MistRelay is a Telegram bot-based aria2 download control system that automatically uploads completed downloads to OneDrive via rclone, integrates file direct link generation, supports Docker one-click deployment, provides a web management interface with multi-dimensional data integrity verification, and offers a standalone Windows desktop client for full-process automation of download, upload and management.

metadata.name: Agent-Reach
metadata.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.

summary.zh: Agent Reach 是面向AI Agent的互联网能力接入CLI工具，零API费用即可支持Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、B站、小红书等主流平台的内容读取与搜索，解决AI Agent无法直接访问互联网内容的痛点，无需手动配置爬虫、API或处理平台风控，开箱即用。
summary.en: Agent Reach is a CLI tool that equips AI agents with internet access capabilities, enabling content reading and search across mainstream platforms including Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu at zero API cost. It solves the pain point of AI agents being unable to directly access online content, requiring no manual configuration of crawlers, APIs or anti-scraping workarounds, and works out of the box.

metadata.name: nodewarden
metadata.description: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers

summary.zh: NodeWarden 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Bitwarden 兼容自托管密码服务器，无需传统服务器即可快速部署，支持多端客户端同步、离线PWA、TOTP验证、增量云备份等官方免费版未提供的功能，适合个人及小团队低成本搭建私有密码管理服务。
summary.en: NodeWarden is a Bitwarden-compatible self-hosted password server built on Cloudflare Workers, deployable in minutes without traditional servers. It supports multi-device sync, offline PWA, TOTP authentication, incremental cloud backup and other features not offered in Bitwarden Free, making it ideal for individuals and small teams to build low-cost private password management services.

metadata.name: warden-worker
metadata.description: A Bitwarden-compatible server for Cloudflare Workers

summary.zh: Warden 是一款兼容 Bitwarden 的无服务器密码管理服务端，可部署至 Cloudflare Workers，依托 D1 存储实现零成本、低维护的个人密码托管。支持官方客户端同步、TOTP、加密文件分享等核心功能，无需服务器运维，适合个人轻量自托管密码管理场景。
summary.en: Warden is a Bitwarden-compatible serverless password management backend deployable on Cloudflare Workers, leveraging D1 storage for zero-cost, low-maintenance personal password hosting. It supports official client sync, TOTP, encrypted file sharing and other core functions, requiring no server operation and maintenance, suitable for lightweight personal self-hosted password management scenarios.

metadata.name: iptv-m3u-manager
metadata.description: IPTV M3U 管理器

summary.zh: IPTV M3U订阅聚合与管理工具，支持多源合并、关键字/正则筛选、自定义分组，内置EPG补全、AI视觉检测/排序、频道连通性探测能力，支持Docker一键部署、静态订阅导出，适配PC/移动端双布局。
summary.en: An IPTV M3U subscription aggregation and management tool that supports multi-source merging, keyword/regex filtering, and custom grouping. It comes with built-in EPG completion, AI visual detection/sorting, channel connectivity probing, one-click Docker deployment, static subscription export, and dual layouts for PC and mobile.

metadata.name: kgcheckin
metadata.description: 酷狗概念VIP自动签到

summary.zh: 基于GitHub Actions实现的酷狗概念VIP自动签到工具，支持二维码、手机号双登录方式，每日自动领取VIP权益，内置多平台结果通知、登录Token自动刷新与仓库保活机制，仅供技术学习研究使用。
summary.en: An automatic check-in tool for KuGou Concept VIP based on GitHub Actions, supporting both QR code and phone number login methods. It automatically claims daily VIP benefits, with built-in multi-platform result notification, login token auto-refresh and repository keep-alive mechanism, for technical learning and research only.

summary.zh: 该插件是OpenWrt路由系统的LuCI推送工具，继承自ServerChan项目并优化推送渠道，支持钉钉、企业微信、飞书、Bark等10余种消息推送，可实现设备上下线、IP变更、CPU负载等状态监控与多端通知，解决微信推送信息不直观的痛点。
summary.en: This is a LuCI push plugin designed for OpenWrt router systems, evolved from the ServerChan project with optimized push channels. It supports over 10 push services including DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu and Bark, enabling status monitoring for device online/offline, IP change, CPU load and multi-terminal notification, solving the pain point of unintuitive WeChat push information.

summary.zh: 基于LuatOS开发的Air780E 4G模块短信转发系统，支持关键词与正则匹配规则，可将短信异步转发至企业微信、飞书、钉钉、自定义Webhook及邮件等多渠道，具备网络容错、低功耗运行、设备信息自动附加等特性，适用于各类短信自动化通知场景。
summary.en: An SMS forwarding system built on LuatOS for Air780E 4G module, supporting keyword and regular expression matching. It asynchronously forwards SMS to multiple channels including WeCom, Feishu, DingTalk, custom Webhook and email, featuring network fault tolerance, low-power operation and automatic device info attachment, suitable for various automated SMS notification scenarios.

summary.zh: MageKit是基于Rust与GPUI框架开发的跨平台桌面视频下载工具，以yt-dlp为核心下载引擎，支持YouTube、Bilibili等主流平台视频下载，具备多任务并发、主题切换、依赖工具自动管理等功能，提供GPU加速的流畅界面体验。
summary.en: MageKit is a cross-platform desktop video downloader built with Rust and the GPUI framework, powered by yt-dlp as the core download engine. It supports downloading videos from mainstream platforms like YouTube and Bilibili, featuring multi-task concurrent download, theme switching, automatic dependency tool management, and a GPU-accelerated smooth interface.

metadata.name: movecar
metadata.description: 🚗 智能挪车通知系统 - 基于 Cloudflare Workers，支持实时位置共享和多推送服务

summary.zh: 面向车主挪车场景的隐私保护通知系统，基于Cloudflare Workers无服务器架构，以推送通知替代暴露手机号的传统挪车码，支持双向位置核验、恶意骚扰拦截机制，免费部署且零运维成本，解决被堵车联系车主难、隐私泄露的痛点。
summary.en: A privacy-preserving car-moving notification system for vehicle owners, built on Cloudflare Workers serverless architecture. It replaces traditional QR codes exposing phone numbers with push notifications, supports two-way location verification and harassment blocking, features free deployment with zero maintenance cost, solving the pain points of being unable to contact blocked car owners and privacy leakage.

metadata.name: dysync.net
metadata.description: 视频同步工具

summary.zh: 抖小云（dysync.net）是基于.NET Core与Vue开发的抖音内容同步工具，支持多账号同步收藏夹、「我喜欢」及指定博主视频，内置视频信息刮削能力，同步后的内容可直接接入Emby、Jellyfin等媒体服务器播放，提供Docker一键部署与路径映射方案。
summary.en: Dysync.net (Douxiaoyun) is a Douyin content synchronization tool built with .NET Core and Vue. It supports multi-account sync of favorites, liked videos and specified creator content, with built-in video metadata scraping. Synced content can be directly played on media servers like Emby and Jellyfin, with Docker one-click deployment supported.

metadata.name: go-wxpush
metadata.description: 极简且免费的微信消息推送服务 (基于golang)

summary.zh: 本项目是基于Golang开发的极简免费微信消息推送服务，依托微信测试公众号模板消息能力提供轻量HTTP API，支持Docker一键部署（镜像仅2MB），每日10万次免费推送额度，自带消息详情页，适用于服务器告警、个人消息通知等场景，部署成本极低。
summary.en: This is a minimalist free WeChat message push service developed with Golang, providing a lightweight HTTP API based on the template message function of WeChat test official accounts. It supports one-click Docker deployment with an image size of only 2MB, offers 100,000 free daily push quotas, and includes a built-in message detail page. It is suitable for scenarios such as server alarms and personal notifications, with very low deployment cost.

metadata.name: trackerslist
metadata.description: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers

summary.zh: 该仓库提供每日自动更新的公开BitTorrent tracker列表，覆盖UDP/HTTP/HTTPS/WS/I2P等多协议类型，同时提供IP直连版本解决DNS解析问题，已做去重与黑名单过滤，可直接用于BT下载客户端配置，提升下载连接成功率。
summary.en: This repository offers daily auto-updated public BitTorrent tracker lists, covering protocols including UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, WS and I2P, with IP-only versions to address DNS resolution issues. The lists are deduplicated and filtered with blacklists, suitable for BT download client configuration to improve download connection success rate.

metadata.name: renewhelper
metadata.description: RenewHelper - 时序·守望是一款基于Cloudflare Workers的全栈服务生命周期提醒、管理工具。它专为管理周期性订阅、域名续费、服务器到期等场景设计。无需服务器，零成本托管，提供精美的机甲风（Mecha-style）UI 界面、强大的农历/公历计算核心、多渠道通知推送能力、iCal日程同步以及账单管理功能。同时支持Worker和Docker方式部署。

summary.zh: RenewHelper（时序·守望）是基于Cloudflare Workers的全栈服务生命周期管理工具，专为订阅续费、域名/服务器到期提醒等场景设计，无需自有服务器即可零成本托管，支持农历/公历周期计算、多渠道通知推送、iCal日程同步及账单管理，提供机甲风UI，支持Worker与Docker双部署。
summary.en: RenewHelper is a full-stack service lifecycle management tool built on Cloudflare Workers, designed for scenarios such as subscription renewals, domain and server expiration reminders. It enables zero-cost hosting without self-owned servers, featuring lunar/gregorian cycle calculation, multi-channel notification push, iCal sync and billing management, with mecha-style UI and dual deployment options of Worker and Docker.

metadata.name: uart_sms_forwarder
metadata.description: Air780 短信UART转发器

summary.zh: 基于合宙Air780系列4G模块的短信UART转发系统，下位机运行Lua脚本实现短信收发，上位机服务通过串口交互，支持短信/来电通知多平台推送、短信记录、定时发送等功能，提供Docker与原生部署方式，适用于物联网短信管理场景。
summary.en: A SMS UART forwarding system built on Air780 series 4G modules. The lower-end device runs Lua scripts for SMS sending and receiving, and the host service communicates via serial port. It supports multi-platform push for SMS and call alerts, SMS logging, scheduled sending, and offers Docker and native deployment options, suitable for IoT SMS management scenarios.

metadata.name: argosbx
metadata.description: 小白自建代理神器！ArgoSBX一键无交互小钢炮脚本💣：Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核自动搭配；支持VPS、Docker、容器多环境部署；套CDN的5大方案+套WARP的15种组合；已支持协议：Naiveproxy、AnyTLS、Any-reality、Vless-xhttp-reality-vision-enc、Vless-tcp-reality-vision、Vless-xhttp-vision-enc、Vless-ws-vision-enc、Shadowsocks-2022、Hysteria2、Tuic、Socks5、Vmess-ws、Argo临时/固定隧道

summary.zh: Argosbx是面向小白的代理节点一键部署工具，集成Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核自动适配，支持VPS、Docker等多环境部署，内置15种WARP出站组合、5套CDN抗封方案，覆盖Naiveproxy、Hysteria2等主流代理协议，无交互操作即可快速搭建可解锁流媒体、抗IP封禁的代理节点。
summary.en: Argosbx is a one-click proxy node deployment tool designed for beginners, integrating Sing-box, Xray and Argo kernels for automatic matching. It supports multi-environment deployment such as VPS and Docker, with 15 WARP outbound combinations and 5 CDN anti-blocking schemes built-in, covering mainstream proxy protocols like Naiveproxy and Hysteria2, enabling fast deployment of streaming-unblocking, IP-blocking resistant proxy nodes without interactive operations.
tags_zh: 一键部署 流媒体解锁

summary.zh: CFnew是基于Cloudflare Workers的代理订阅管理工具，支持VLESS、Trojan等多协议，内置订阅转换、优选IP延迟测试与动态管理，提供图形化配置界面，适配Clash、Surge等主流代理客户端，无需依赖外部转换服务，配置保存即时生效，支持多语言。
summary.en: CFnew is a proxy subscription management tool built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting multi-protocols including VLESS and Trojan. It features built-in subscription conversion, optimal IP latency testing and dynamic management, a graphical configuration interface, compatibility with mainstream proxy clients like Clash and Surge, no dependency on external conversion services, and instant configuration effect upon saving, with multi-language support.

metadata.name: whistle
metadata.description: HTTP, HTTP2, HTTPS, Websocket debugging proxy

summary.zh: Whistle是基于Node.js的跨平台网络抓包调试代理，支持HTTP/HTTPS/HTTP2/WebSocket/TCP协议的抓包与请求响应篡改，提供HTTP/HTTPS/Socks/反向代理等多种代理模式，内置Weinre、Console、Composer等调试工具，支持规则配置与插件扩展，适用于前后端联调、接口测试、线上问题排查等场景。
summary.en: Whistle is a Node.js-based cross-platform network debugging proxy tool that supports capturing, modifying and replaying HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, WebSocket and TCP traffic, provides multiple proxy modes such as HTTP, HTTPS, Socks and reverse proxy, integrates built-in debugging tools including Weinre for remote DOM inspection, Console for log viewing and Composer for request editing, supports rule-based traffic modification and plugin extensibility, and can be used for frontend-backend joint debugging, API testing, online issue troubleshooting and network traffic analysis scenarios.

metadata.name: bilibili-video-downloader
metadata.description: 哔哩哔哩 bilibili B站 视频 下载器，图形界面 + nfo刮削 + 广告标记 + 字幕下载 + 弹幕下载，轻松将视频加入emby等媒体库

summary.zh: 这是一款基于Tauri v2开发的跨平台B站视频下载工具，支持普通视频、番剧、课程等全类型内容下载，具备分片下载、NFO刮削、字幕/弹幕/广告标记等功能，可无缝对接Emby等媒体库，轻量易用。
summary.en: This is a cross-platform Bilibili video downloader built with Tauri v2, supporting full-type content download including regular videos, anime series and courses. It features segmented download, NFO scraping, subtitle/danmaku/ad marking, and can seamlessly integrate with media libraries like Emby, with a lightweight and user-friendly GUI.

metadata.name: TVAPP
metadata.description: 收集全网 Android TV电视盒子应用，涵盖影视、直播、K歌、工具、游戏等类型，整理优质APK资源，支持便捷下载与自动更新。提供安全验证、分类索引与兼容性标注，助力用户打造家庭影音娱乐中心！              ✅ TVBox/影视仓等影音壳接口配置源。

summary.zh: 本仓库为安卓TV/电视盒子应用资源合集，整合影视、直播、K歌、工具等多类优质APK，提供TVBox、影视仓等影音壳的接口配置源，标注系统兼容性与安全验证，支持便捷下载与自动更新，助力用户快速搭建家庭影音娱乐中心。
summary.en: This repository is a collection of Android TV and set-top box applications, integrating high-quality APKs for video, live streaming, karaoke, tools and more. It provides interface configuration sources for media shells like TVBox and Yingshi Cang, marks system compatibility and security verification, supports easy download and auto-update, helping users quickly build a home audio-visual entertainment center.

metadata.name: free-nodes
metadata.description: 免费节点订阅：Clash、V2RayN、Shadowrocket｜Base64 与 YAML 每 2 小时更新

summary.zh: 免费公开的代理节点订阅聚合工具，适配Clash、V2RayN、Shadowrocket等主流客户端，每2小时自动更新，提供Base64通用与Clash YAML两种标准化订阅格式，自动校验数据完整性、统一节点地理标识，不承诺节点可用性，附带完整导入指南与合规安全提示。
summary.en: Public free proxy node subscription aggregation tool, compatible with mainstream clients including Clash, V2RayN and Shadowrocket, updates automatically every 2 hours. It provides two standardized subscription formats: universal Base64 and Clash YAML, with automatic data integrity verification, unified node geographic labeling, no guarantee of node availability, complete import guides and compliance security tips.

metadata.name: go-rename
metadata.description: go-rename 照片视频重命名工具 支持Windows/MacOS/Linux等各平台

summary.zh: 基于Golang开发的跨平台照片视频重命名工具，解决不同设备拍摄文件命名重复、整理不便的问题，支持按EXIF拍摄时间、文件创建/修改时间或MD5值重命名，可自动处理同名文件，兼容Windows/MacOS/Linux多架构。
summary.en: A cross-platform photo and video renaming tool developed with Golang, solving the problems of duplicate filenames and disorganized files shot by different devices. It supports renaming based on EXIF shooting time, file creation/modification time or MD5 value, automatically handles duplicate filenames, and is compatible with Windows/MacOS/Linux multi-architecture.

metadata.name: BiliTools
metadata.description: 本项目已停止维护。

summary.zh: 本项目是面向哔哩哔哩平台的第三方工具项目，曾为用户提供B站相关功能服务，因收到平台委托律所发来的侵权及不正当竞争指控，综合考虑法律风险、维护成本等因素，项目已停止维护，不再进行版本更新与问题处理。
summary.en: This is a third-party utility project for the Bilibili platform, which once provided Bilibili-related functional services for users. After receiving a legal letter from a law firm commissioned by Bilibili accusing it of infringement and unfair competition, the project has ceased maintenance considering factors such as legal risks and maintenance costs, and will no longer carry out version updates and issue handling.

metadata.name: GitHubDaily
metadata.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.

summary.zh: GitHubDaily是2015年成立的优质开源项目聚合平台，累计分享超1万个覆盖AI工具、开发工具、学习教程等类别的开源项目，帮助开发者发现优质开源资源、追踪技术动态、提升编程能力，同时支持社区项目推荐。
summary.en: GitHubDaily is a curated open-source project aggregation platform founded in 2015, having shared over 10,000 high-quality open-source projects spanning AI tools, development tools, learning tutorials and more. It helps developers discover valuable open-source resources, track tech trends and improve programming skills, while supporting community project recommendations.

metadata.name: chinese-independent-developer
metadata.description: 👩🏿‍💻👨🏾‍💻👩🏼‍💻👨🏽‍💻👩🏻‍💻中国独立开发者项目列表 -- 分享大家都在做什么

summary.zh: 本仓库聚合中国独立开发者的已上线可直接使用的网站与App项目，按使用场景分类（含程序员向、游戏向等子版面），配套可搜索、每日自动同步的可视化导航站，为开发者、创业者提供项目灵感与实用工具发现渠道，支持通过PR/Issue贡献项目。
summary.en: This repository aggregates launched, ready-to-use websites and apps from Chinese independent developers, categorized by use case with sub-sections for programmer-focused and game projects. Paired with a searchable, daily auto-synced visual navigation site, it provides a channel for developers and entrepreneurs to discover project inspiration and practical tools, and accepts contributions via PR or Issue.

metadata.name: free-proxy-list
metadata.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)

summary.zh: Proxifly免费代理列表项目每5分钟自动更新，提供HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4、SOCKS5四类共2100+可用代理节点，覆盖112个国家，支持JSON/TXT/CSV多格式下载与API调用，无重复节点且经过有效性校验，适用于网页爬虫、跨境网络访问等场景。
summary.en: Proxifly free proxy list project updates automatically every 5 minutes, providing over 2100 working HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 proxies from 112 countries. It supports multi-format download (JSON/TXT/CSV) and API access, with deduplication and validity verification, suitable for web scraping, cross-border network access and other scenarios.

metadata.name: ai-goofish-monitor
metadata.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。

summary.zh: 基于Playwright与AI大模型实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控系统，配套完整Web管理后台，支持自然语言创建任务、多模态商品智能分析、多渠道通知、多账号代理轮换，可一键Docker部署，帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中快速筛选心仪产品。
summary.en: An AI-powered Xianyu multi-task real-time/scheduled monitoring system built on Playwright and large language models, with a complete web admin UI. It supports natural language task creation, multimodal product analysis, multi-channel notifications, multi-account proxy rotation, and one-click Docker deployment, helping users quickly find desired products from Xianyu.

summary.zh: 本项目是针对斐讯R1智能音箱的IoT改造开源方案，核心服务基于Java开发，提供Docker镜像支持一键部署，可配置持久化存储与自定义访问密码，能将闲置的斐讯R1音箱接入智能家居生态，实现老旧智能硬件的再利用。
summary.en: This open-source project is an IoT modification solution for the Phicomm R1 smart speaker, with core services built in Java. It offers a Docker image for one-click deployment, supports persistent configuration storage and custom access passwords, allowing idle Phicomm R1 speakers to integrate into smart home ecosystems to repurpose legacy smart devices.

metadata.name: pansou
metadata.description: PanSou是一款高性能的网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件搜索。系统设计以性能和可扩展性为核心，支持多频道多插件并发搜索、结果智能排序和网盘类型分类。docker集成前后端，一键启动，开箱即用。仅供学习研究，请勿以各种形式用于盈利目的。 https://t.me/s/webhtv

summary.zh: PanSou是一款高性能网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道与自定义插件并发搜索，具备智能排序、多网盘类型识别、二级缓存能力，提供Docker一键部署的前后端集成方案，仅供学习研究使用。
summary.en: PanSou is a high-performance cloud storage resource search API service that supports concurrent search via Telegram channels and custom plugins. It features intelligent ranking, multi-cloud storage type identification, and secondary caching, and provides a Docker-based all-in-one frontend-backend deployment solution for learning and research purposes only.

metadata.name: OpenList
metadata.description: A new AList Fork to Anti Trust Crisis

summary.zh: OpenList是为应对信任危机推出的AList社区驱动开源分叉，基于AGPL-3.0协议保持代码完全开源透明，支持本地存储、阿里云盘、OneDrive、GoogleDrive等数十种云存储与协议存储的统一文件管理，可跨平台部署，为用户提供安全的云资源聚合访问能力。
summary.en: OpenList is a community-driven, resilient open-source fork of AList launched to counter trust-based attacks, operating under the AGPL-3.0 license with full code transparency. It enables unified file management across dozens of storages including local storage, Aliyundrive, OneDrive, GoogleDrive, FTP/SFTP, supports cross-platform deployment, and provides secure aggregated access to cloud resources.

metadata.name: ChinaTextbook
metadata.description: 所有小初高、大学PDF教材。

summary.zh: 本项目开源整合国内小初高至大学全学段正版教材PDF，旨在打破付费水印教材的信息垄断，推动义务教育普惠、弥合区域教育差距，同时为海外华人子女提供免费国内课程资源，所有内容可公开免费获取。
summary.en: This repository open-sources a complete collection of official Chinese textbook PDFs spanning from primary school to university levels. It aims to break the monopoly of watermarked paid textbooks, promote inclusive compulsory education, bridge regional education gaps, and provide free domestic curriculum resources for overseas Chinese children, with all content publicly accessible at no cost.

metadata.name: Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller
metadata.description: Remove large amounts of unwanted applications quickly.

summary.zh: Bulk Crap Uninstaller（BCU）是一款Apache 2.0开源免费的Windows批量卸载工具，支持快速批量移除大量应用、清理卸载残留、检测孤立程序，兼容Windows商店应用、Steam及NSIS、InnoSetup等常见安装包格式，适用于个人系统清理与IT运维场景，基于.NET框架开发。
summary.en: Bulk Crap Uninstaller (BCU) is a free, open-source Windows batch uninstaller under the Apache 2.0 license. It supports fast bulk removal of unwanted apps, cleanup of uninstallation leftovers, detection of orphaned programs, and is compatible with Windows Store apps, Steam, and common installer formats such as NSIS and InnoSetup, serving both personal system cleanup and IT operation scenarios, built on the .NET framework.

metadata.name: SaveAny-Bot
metadata.description: Save Any Telegram File to Anywhere 📂 (Alist, Disk, Webdav, S3, Rclone...) . Support restrict saving content and files beyond telegram.

summary.zh: SaveAny-Bot是一款Telegram文件自动化管理工具，支持绕过平台内容保存限制，将聊天中的文件批量转存至Alist、S3、WebDAV等多类存储后端，集成yt-dlp、Aria2实现跨站资源下载，支持自定义JS插件扩展与自动归档规则，适用于个人文件备份、资源采集等场景。
summary.en: SaveAny-Bot is a Telegram file automation tool that bypasses platform content saving restrictions, supports batch transferring files from chats to multiple storage backends such as Alist, S3 and WebDAV, integrates with yt-dlp and Aria2 for cross-site resource downloading, supports custom JS plugin extension and automatic archiving rules, suitable for personal file backup and resource collection.

metadata.name: Deadpool
metadata.description: deadpool代理池工具，可从hunter、quake、fofa等网络空间测绘平台取高质量socks5代理，或本地导入socks5代理，轮询使用代理进行流量转发。

summary.zh: Deadpool是开源Socks5代理池工具，支持从Hunter、Quake、FOFA等网络空间测绘平台自动采集高质量代理，也可本地导入，通过轮询策略实现流量转发，面向合法授权的网络安全测试场景，具备代理健康检测、优雅关闭、多工具适配等特性，解决攻防演练中IP被封的代理需求。
summary.en: Deadpool is an open-source SOCKS5 proxy pool tool that automatically collects high-quality proxies from network space mapping platforms like Hunter, Quake and FOFA, also supports local proxy import, and realizes traffic forwarding through polling strategy. Oriented to authorized network security testing scenarios, it features proxy health check, graceful shutdown and multi-tool adaptation, solving the proxy demand when IP is blocked in offensive and defensive drills.

metadata.name: DailyHotApi
metadata.description: 🔥 今日热榜 API，一个聚合热门数据的 API 接口，支持 RSS 模式 及 Vercel 部署 | 前端页面：https://github.com/imsyy/DailyHot

summary.zh: 聚合B站、微博、知乎、抖音等多平台热门榜单的统一API接口，支持JSON与RSS双模式输出，响应速度快、部署方式灵活，可快速集成多平台热榜数据，降低热榜应用开发成本，适用于资讯聚合、数据采集等场景。
summary.en: A unified API service that aggregates hot trending lists from dozens of mainstream platforms including Bilibili, Weibo, Zhihu, Douyin and Baidu, supporting both JSON and RSS output modes. It features fast response speed, flexible deployment options and clear extensible route design, enabling developers to quickly integrate multi-platform trending data, greatly reducing the development cost of trending aggregation applications, suitable for scenarios like news aggregation, data monitoring and content operation.

metadata.name: yt-dlp
metadata.description: A feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader

summary.zh: yt-dlp 是功能丰富的命令行音视频下载工具，fork 自 youtube-dl，支持上千个站点的内容抓取与下载，具备格式筛选、SponsorBlock 去广告、字幕下载、后处理等特性，适用于内容归档、离线观看、媒体资源采集等场景，支持插件扩展与项目嵌入。
summary.en: yt-dlp is a feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader forked from youtube-dl, supporting content capture and download from thousands of sites. It features format filtering, SponsorBlock ad removal, subtitle download, post-processing, etc., suitable for content archiving, offline viewing and media resource collection, with plugin extension and project embeddability.

metadata.name: proxy-scraper
metadata.description: ⭐️ A proxy scraper made using Protractor | Proxy list Updates every three hour 🔥

summary.zh: 该工具基于Protractor与Node.js开发，可自动化爬取公开代理资源，每3小时更新1700+条代理，支持HTTP/S、SOCKS4/5多类型，可导出TXT、JSON等5种格式，支持存储至MySQL数据库，附带代理可用性测试脚本，适用于爬虫、网络测试等场景。
summary.en: This tool, built with Protractor and Node.js, automatically scrapes public proxies, updating 1700+ entries every 3 hours. It supports HTTP/S, SOCKS4/5 types, exports to 5 formats like TXT/JSON, supports MySQL storage, and includes proxy usability test scripts, suitable for web scraping and network testing.

metadata.description: 主要搜集tvbox配置文件

summary.zh: 该仓库是爱好者维护的TVBox配置资源合集，聚合可直接导入的直播、影视播放源配置，免去用户自行搜集、校验IPTV源的繁琐流程，满足个人流媒体播放器快速部署需求，属于轻量级开源资源库。
summary.en: This is an enthusiast-maintained open-source repository collecting TVBox configuration files. It aggregates ready-to-import live TV and video source configurations, sparing users the hassle of manually searching and verifying IPTV sources, enabling quick deployment of personal streaming players.

metadata.name: PROXY-List
metadata.description: Get PROXY List  that gets updated everyday

summary.zh: 该仓库提供每日更新的免费公开代理资源集合，涵盖SOCKS5、SOCKS4、HTTP三类共8000+代理节点，支持一键下载获取，配套可用性自动化检测工具，适用于爬虫开发、网络访问测试等场景，明确标注仅用于教育用途。
summary.en: This repository offers a daily updated collection of free public proxy resources, covering over 8000 proxy nodes of SOCKS5, SOCKS4 and HTTP types, supports one-click download, and is equipped with an automated proxy availability detection tool. It is applicable to scenarios like crawler development and network access testing, and is explicitly marked for educational use only.

metadata.name: lx-music-mobile
metadata.description: 一个基于 React native 开发的音乐软件

summary.zh: LX Music移动版是基于React Native与Redux开发的开源音乐播放器，支持Android 5+系统，可聚合多平台官方音乐资源，支持本地播放列表管理及自部署多端数据同步，满足个人音乐收听与资源管理需求，遵循Apache 2.0补充开源协议。
summary.en: LX Music Mobile is an open-source music player built with React Native and Redux, supporting Android 5 and above. It aggregates official music resources from multiple platforms, supports local playlist management and self-deployable multi-device data sync, catering to personal music listening and resource management needs under the Apache 2.0 supplemented license.

metadata.name: breezy-weather
metadata.description: A feature-rich weather app with good visualizations and more than 50 sources.

summary.zh: Breezy Weather是一款免费开源的安卓天气应用，基于Kotlin与Jetpack Compose开发，采用Material 3 Expressive设计规范，支持50余种天气数据源，提供天气预报、空气质量、花粉指数、灾害预警等功能，具备优秀的数据可视化能力，可通过GitHub、F-Droid等渠道获取。
summary.en: Breezy Weather is a free and open-source Android weather app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, following Material 3 Expressive design guidelines. It supports over 50 weather data sources, offering features like weather forecast, air quality monitoring, pollen index, disaster alerts, and well-designed data visualizations, available via GitHub, F-Droid and other channels.

metadata.name: GitHubDesktop2Chinese
metadata.description: GithubDesktop语言本地化(汉化)工具 【GitHub桌面客户端中文汉化】

summary.zh: 本工具是GitHub Desktop官方无原生中文界面的轻量汉化解决方案，采用C++开发，通过正则匹配替换客户端资源文件实现界面汉化，具备高版本兼容性、自动获取汉化包、选择性替换、异常回滚等特性，大幅降低汉化维护成本。
summary.en: This tool is a lightweight Chinese localization solution for GitHub Desktop which lacks an official native Chinese interface. Developed in C++, it realizes interface localization by replacing client resource files via regex matching, featuring high version compatibility, automatic localization package acquisition, selective replacement and exception rollback, greatly reducing localization maintenance costs.

metadata.name: lxmusic-
metadata.description: lxmusic(洛雪音乐)全网最新最全音源

summary.zh: 本仓库为LX Music、澜音等开源音乐客户端提供全网聚合音源，支持免费及付费音源一键导入，解决多平台音乐资源分散问题，配套长期运维更新与社区服务，满足用户多平台音乐收听需求。
summary.en: This repository provides full-network aggregated audio sources for open-source music clients such as LX Music and Ceru Music, supports one-click import of free and paid audio sources, solves the problem of scattered music resources across platforms, and offers long-term operation, maintenance, update and community services to meet users' cross-platform music listening needs.

metadata.name: Douyin_TikTok_Download_API
metadata.description: 🚀「Douyin_TikTok_Download_API」是一个开箱即用的高性能异步抖音、快手、TikTok、Bilibili数据爬取工具，支持API调用，在线批量解析及下载。

summary.zh: Douyin_TikTok_Download_API 是开箱即用的高性能异步多平台短视频数据爬取工具，支持抖音、快手、TikTok、Bilibili 等主流平台的 API 调用、在线批量解析与无水印下载，可快速集成到内容采集、数据分析等业务场景。
summary.en: Douyin_TikTok_Download_API is an out-of-the-box high-performance asynchronous multi-platform short video data scraping tool, supporting API calls, online batch parsing and watermark-free download for mainstream platforms such as Douyin, Kuaishou, TikTok and Bilibili, and can be rapidly integrated into scenarios like content collection and data analysis.

metadata.name: notepad--
metadata.description: 一个支持windows/linux/mac的文本编辑器，目标是做中国人自己的编辑器，来自中国。

summary.zh: Notepad--是一款支持Windows、Linux、macOS的轻量级跨平台文本编辑器，核心目标是实现文本编辑类软件的国产替代，重点适配国产信创UOS等操作系统，为国内用户提供自主可控的文本编辑解决方案。
summary.en: Notepad-- is a lightweight cross-platform text editor supporting Windows, Linux and macOS, aiming to serve as a domestic alternative for text editing software, with a focus on adapting to domestic trusted computing systems such as UOS, providing users with autonomous and controllable text editing solutions.

metadata.name: HelloGitHub
metadata.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.

summary.zh: HelloGitHub是面向开源新手的精选月刊项目，每月28日更新，汇总GitHub上有趣、入门级的开源项目、开源书籍及实战案例，配套官网与公众号渠道，降低开源探索门槛，帮助开发者快速感受开源魅力。
summary.en: HelloGitHub is a curated monthly publication for open source beginners, updated on the 28th of each month. It compiles interesting, entry-level open source projects, books and practical cases from GitHub, supported by official website and official channels, lowering the barrier to open source exploration and helping developers quickly feel its charm.

metadata.name: BPB-Worker-Panel
metadata.description: A GUI Panel providing Worker subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan and Warp configs alongside a private DoH server and chain proxies, offering full DNS, clean IP,  Fragment, Warp, Warp pro and routing settings for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores.

summary.zh: BPB Worker Panel 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的免费私有代理工具面板，提供 VLESS、Trojan、Warp 协议订阅配置与私有 DoH 服务，支持链式代理、流量分片、自定义路由规则，可快速部署并适配 Xray、Sing-box、Clash 等跨平台客户端，解决网络封锁与隐私访问问题。
summary.en: BPB Worker Panel is a free, private proxy tool panel built on Cloudflare Workers, offering VLESS, Trojan and Warp protocol subscription configs alongside a private DoH server. It supports chain proxies, traffic fragmentation, custom routing rules, enables quick deployment and is compatible with cross-platform clients like Xray, Sing-box and Clash, addressing network blocking and private access demands.

metadata.name: NetMount
metadata.description: 统一管理和挂载云存储设施/Unified management and mounting of cloud storage facilities

summary.zh: NetMount是基于Rust、TypeScript、Tauri与React开发的跨平台桌面工具，底层集成Rclone与OpenList能力，可统一管理、挂载各类云存储服务，实现本地直接访问云端文件，解决多云存储分散管理、频繁切换平台的痛点，提升文件操作效率。
summary.en: NetMount is a cross-platform desktop tool built with Rust, TypeScript, Tauri and React. Integrated with Rclone and OpenList, it unifies management and mounting of various cloud storage services, enabling direct local access to cloud files, solving the pain points of fragmented multi-cloud management and frequent platform switching, and improving file operation efficiency.

metadata.name: HotPEToolBox
metadata.description: 一个纯净、强大、优雅的WinPE

summary.zh: 这是HotPE官方构建工具仓库，可用于生成纯净、强大、优雅的Win11 PE系统，支持网络连接、远程控制、多硬件兼容、BitLocker磁盘解锁、U盘/本地启动等丰富功能，基于Python开发，适配Win10/11原版镜像，遵循MIT协议开源。
summary.en: This is the official build tool repository for HotPE, designed to generate a clean, powerful and elegant Win11 PE system. It supports rich features such as network connectivity, remote control, multi-hardware compatibility, BitLocker disk unlocking, USB/local boot, etc. Built with Python, it is compatible with original Win10/11 system images and open-sourced under the MIT license.

metadata.name: GoGoGo
metadata.description: 一个基于 Android 调试 API + 百度地图实现的虚拟定位工具，并且同时实现了一个可以自由移动的摇杆

summary.zh: 影梭是一款无需ROOT权限的Android虚拟定位工具，基于Android调试API与百度地图实现，支持定位修改、摇杆模拟移动、坐标输入等功能，可用于学习安卓定位技术，明确禁止用于游戏或校园运动作弊。
summary.en: Yingsuo is a ROOT-free Android virtual location tool built on Android Debug API and Baidu Map, supporting location modification, joystick-controlled movement simulation, coordinate input and other functions. It is designed for learning Android location technology, and cheating in games or campus sports is strictly prohibited.

metadata.name: iptv-api
metadata.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署

summary.zh: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具，支持自动采集、多源聚合、可用性校验、测速筛选，可自定义频道并以M3U/TXT/API格式输出，提供CLI、GUI、Docker等跨平台部署方案，适配IPv4/IPv6，导入播放器即可直接观看。
summary.en: An IPTV live source auto-update tool supporting automatic collection, multi-source aggregation, availability validation and speed filtering. It allows custom channel configuration, outputs in M3U/TXT/API formats, and offers cross-platform deployment via CLI, GUI and Docker, compatible with IPv4/IPv6, ready to import into players for direct viewing.

metadata.name: taosync
metadata.description: TaoSync是一个适用于OpenList v3+的自动化同步工具/Sync for OpenList/AList

summary.zh: TaoSync是开源免费的跨平台自动化文件同步工具，兼容OpenList/AList v3+且内置存储引擎无需依赖OpenList，支持多存储端同步备份、定时下载任务，覆盖全主流操作系统与架构，提供可视化操作界面与通知能力。
summary.en: TaoSync is an open-source, free cross-platform automated file synchronization tool. It is compatible with OpenList/AList v3+, and features a built-in storage engine that removes the dependency on OpenList. It supports multi-storage sync, backup and scheduled download tasks, covering all mainstream OS and architectures, with a visual interface and notification capabilities.

metadata.name: Cloudflare-vless-trojan
metadata.description: CF-workers/pages代理脚本：支持Vless-ws(tls)、Trojan-ws(tls)；Socks5/http本地代理脚本：可选ECH-TLS、普通TLS、无TLS三种代理模式

summary.zh: 这是面向新手的Cloudflare代理工具集，基于Workers/Pages可快速搭建VLESS/Trojan的ws/tls代理节点，配套本地Socks5/HTTP代理脚本，支持ECH-TLS、普通TLS、无TLS三种代理模式，内置优选IP与国内外分流能力，无需自定义域名即可部署免费代理节点，适配多客户端订阅格式，有效应对网络封锁。
summary.en: This is a beginner-friendly Cloudflare proxy toolkit for quick deployment of VLESS/Trojan ws/tls proxy nodes via Workers/Pages. With local Socks5/HTTP proxy scripts supporting ECH-TLS, standard TLS, and non-TLS modes, it features built-in optimized IPs and domestic/international traffic splitting, requires no custom domain, supports multi-client subscription formats, and helps bypass network restrictions.

metadata.name: cf-proxy-ex
metadata.description: Cloudflare超级代理，无服务器代理，Duckduckgo代理（可用AI聊天，包含GPT4o/Claude3），Github加速，支持解锁Libgen，在线代理。现已支持多平台部署。Cloudflare super proxy, setting up a free serverless proxy by using Cloudflare worker, support Duckduckgo / Libgen. Now you can deploy this project on different platforms.

summary.zh: 本项目是基于Cloudflare Worker的无服务器在线代理工具，支持多平台部署，可实现Github加速、DuckDuckGo代理（支持GPT4o/Claude3 AI聊天）、Libgen解锁等功能，具备Cookie域管控、相对URL自动转换等特性，仅可用于合规学习场景。
summary.en: This is a serverless online proxy tool built on Cloudflare Worker, supporting multi-platform deployment. It enables GitHub acceleration, DuckDuckGo proxy (with GPT4o/Claude3 AI chat access), Libgen unlocking and other functions, featuring cookie domain management and automatic relative URL conversion, and is restricted to compliant learning scenarios.

metadata.name: NoMoreWalls
metadata.description: 自动抓取合并互联网上的公开节点。

summary.zh: NoMoreWalls是自动抓取合并互联网公开代理节点的开源工具，提供Clash系列订阅及定制分流规则，支持多CDN镜像防失联，采用反996许可证，同时明确使用限制并提示免费节点安全风险。
summary.en: NoMoreWalls is an open-source tool that automatically crawls and merges public proxy nodes from the internet, provides Clash series subscriptions with custom routing rules, supports multi-CDN mirrors to avoid disconnection, adopts an anti-996 license, and clarifies usage restrictions while warning of free node security risks.

metadata.name: tvbox
metadata.description: OK影视、tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。

summary.zh: 本仓库为TVBox及猫影视的聚合配置文件集合，整合多路大神分享的直播、点播影视资源，适配多款TVBox衍生客户端，配套网盘授权配置，面向智能电视/电视盒子用户，可快速搭建个人影音播放环境，仅供学习研究使用，需遵守相关规范。
summary.en: This repository is a collection of aggregated configuration files for TVBox and CatVod, integrating live streaming and on-demand video resources shared by various experts, compatible with multiple TVBox derivative clients, with cloud storage authorization configuration included. It is designed for smart TV and TV box users to quickly build personal video playback environments, for learning and research use only, and relevant regulations shall be complied with.

metadata.name: awesome-cloudflare
metadata.description: ⛅️ 精选的 Cloudflare 工具、开源项目、指南、博客和其他资源列表。/ ⛅️ A curated list of Cloudflare tools, open source projects, guides, blogs and other resources.

summary.zh: 本仓库为Cloudflare生态开源资源精选列表，面向独立开发者，系统收录工具、开源项目、指南、博客等资源，覆盖图床、存储、短链、监控等多类场景，依托Cloudflare Workers、Pages等服务，帮助开发者提升效率、降低成本，降低独立开发门槛。
summary.en: This repository is a curated list of open-source resources in the Cloudflare ecosystem, designed for independent developers. It collects tools, projects, guides, blogs and other materials, covering scenarios such as image hosting, storage, short links and monitoring. Built on Cloudflare Workers, Pages and other services, it helps developers improve efficiency and reduce costs, lowering the threshold for independent development.

metadata.name: httpsok
metadata.description: 🔥🔥🔥一行命令，轻松搞定SSL证书自动续期。 SSL泛域名证书，SSL证书管理，SSL证书自动续期，SSL证书自动更新，七牛云、阿里云、腾讯云、CDN、OSS、https证书管理,https证书管理,免费SSL证书,TLS证书自动续签,nginx证书自动续期工具，nginx证书管理。从此告别Let's Encrypt

summary.zh: httpsok是轻量级SSL证书自动续期运维工具，支持Nginx、Apache等服务器及七牛云、阿里云等云厂商CDN/OSS证书管理，可自动识别服务器证书配置、支持泛域名/多域名续签，一行命令即可完成部署，兼容主流Linux与Docker环境，提供证书到期提醒，替代传统手动续签流程。
summary.en: httpsok is a lightweight SSL certificate auto-renewal operations tool that supports certificate management for Nginx, Apache and other servers, as well as CDN/OSS services of mainstream cloud vendors such as Qiniu, Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud. It automatically identifies server certificate configurations, supports wildcard/multi-domain renewal, deploys with a single command, is compatible with mainstream Linux and Docker environments, and provides certificate expiration alerts to replace traditional manual renewal processes.

metadata.name: Nagram
metadata.description: The third-party Telegram android app.

summary.zh: Nagram是基于NekoX二次开发的第三方Telegram安卓客户端，在保留Telegram基础通讯能力的基础上，新增多协议内置代理、消息交互增强、自定义表情包、国际化优化等实用功能，为安卓用户提供更灵活、个性化的Telegram使用体验。
summary.en: Nagram is a third-party Telegram Android client forked from NekoX. It retains the core messaging functions of Telegram while adding practical features such as built-in multi-protocol proxy, enhanced message interaction, custom sticker packs, and internationalization optimization, providing Android users with a more flexible and personalized Telegram experience.

metadata.name: Sandboxie
metadata.description: Sandboxie Plus & Classic

summary.zh: Sandboxie是Windows平台开源沙箱隔离工具，可在隔离虚拟环境中运行或安装程序，不修改主机系统、映射盘与注册表，支持多沙箱并行、快照管理、隐私控制，适用于不可信程序测试、安全上网等场景，提供Plus（Qt新UI）与Classic双版本。
summary.en: Sandboxie is an open-source sandbox isolation tool for Windows, which enables running or installing applications in an isolated virtual environment without modifying the host system, mapped drives or Windows registry. It supports multi-sandbox parallel operation, snapshot management and privacy control, suitable for untrusted program testing and secure web surfing, and offers Plus (Qt-based new UI) and Classic two editions.

metadata.name: proxypin
metadata.description: Open source free capture HTTP(S) traffic  software ProxyPin, supporting full platform systems

summary.zh: ProxyPin是开源免费的跨平台HTTP/HTTPS流量抓包工具，基于Flutter开发，支持Windows、Mac、移动端、Linux全平台，可拦截、检查、重写网络流量，支持扫码免配置连接、JS脚本处理、请求重写/阻断、HAR导出等功能，适用于接口调试、Flutter应用抓包等场景。
summary.en: ProxyPin is an open-source, free cross-platform HTTP/HTTPS traffic capture tool built with Flutter, supporting Windows, Mac, mobile and Linux systems. It enables traffic interception, inspection and rewriting, and offers features like QR code connection, JS script processing, request rewriting/blocking and HAR export, suitable for API debugging and Flutter app traffic capture.

metadata.name: ecs
metadata.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评项目 更推荐使用无环境依赖的Go版本 VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script – More recommended to use the Go version with no environment dependencies: https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs

summary.zh: 这是VPS服务器综合测评Shell脚本项目，支持Ubuntu、Debian等主流系统及多CPU架构，可一键执行硬件性能、网络质量、IP属性等全维度测试，提供交互与参数两种运行模式，现主推无环境依赖的Go重构版本，适用于云服务器选型、性能排查场景。
summary.en: This is a VPS server comprehensive testing shell script project, supporting mainstream systems such as Ubuntu and Debian and multiple CPU architectures. It enables one-click full-dimensional tests covering hardware performance, network quality and IP attributes, offers both interactive and parameter-based running modes, and now recommends a dependency-free Go rewritten version for cloud server selection and performance troubleshooting scenarios.

metadata.name: FreeNodes
metadata.description: v2ray、clash免费节点爬虫，自动更新

summary.zh: 本项目是AI增强的v2ray/Clash免费节点自动爬虫，每日定时从多个公开节点源抓取有效代理节点，生成标准订阅文件与镜像加速链接，仅供学习交流使用，解决免费节点查找难、更新不及时的核心痛点。
summary.en: This project is an AI-enhanced automatic crawler for free V2Ray/Clash proxy nodes, which runs on a fixed daily schedule to fetch valid nodes from multiple public node sources, generate standard subscription files and mirrored accelerated links for learning and communication only, solving the core pain points of difficult node search and untimely update of free proxy nodes.

summary.zh: 该仓库为自动化免费代理节点采集分享工具，基于GitHub Actions实现全流程自动化，自动爬取全网免费节点池并测速筛选，通过subconverter生成多协议订阅链接与Clash配置，已积累超1100个高速节点，用户可直接导入客户端使用。
summary.en: This repository is an automated free proxy node collection and sharing tool, fully powered by GitHub Actions. It automatically crawls free node pools across the web, filters high-speed nodes via speed testing, generates multi-protocol subscription links and Clash configurations via subconverter, with over 1100 high-speed nodes available for direct import into proxy clients.

metadata.name: X
metadata.description: 如果喜欢，请点亮右上角星星，如有侵权请反馈！谢谢！免责声明：📛本仓库管理者不能保证本仓库内容的合法性、准确性、完整性和有效性，请根据情况自行判断。本仓库内容，仅用于测试和学习研究，禁止用于商业用途，不得将其用于违反国家、地区、组织等的法律法规或相关规定的其他用途，禁止任何公众号、自媒体进行任何形式的转载、发布，请不要在中华人民共和国境内使用本仓库内容，否则后果自负

summary.zh: 该仓库聚合影视点播直播源、TVBox配置接口及接口解密、DNS优选等配套工具，面向影视播放工具、IPTV直播场景的测试学习需求提供资源集合，仅可用于学习研究。
summary.en: This repository aggregates on-demand video sources, live streaming sources, TVBox configuration interfaces and supporting tools like interface decryption and DNS optimization, providing resource collection for the testing and learning needs of video playback tools and IPTV live streaming scenarios, for research use only.

metadata.name: N3RD
metadata.description: CTV

summary.zh: 现有公开信息显示该仓库为N3RD项目，核心面向CTV（联网电视）场景的应用开发需求，提供相关开发能力支撑，可降低智能电视端应用的开发门槛，适配各类应用的构建与落地。
summary.en: Publicly available information about the N3RD repository is limited. It is a project focused on Connected TV (CTV) application development, providing relevant development capabilities to lower the development threshold for smart TV apps, and supporting the construction and deployment of various applications.

metadata.name: GOODBYEADS
metadata.description: 适用于AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS的去广告规则，合并优质上游规则并去重整理排列。

summary.zh: GOODBYEADS是面向AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS等工具的多平台去广告规则集合，合并上游优质规则去重整理，支持多格式输出，提供21万+拦截规则与10万+DNS拦截规则，配套国内加速订阅，定时更新保障拦截效果。
summary.en: GOODBYEADS is a multi-platform ad-blocking rule set compatible with AdGuard, Quantumult X, SmartDNS and other tools. It merges and deduplicates high-quality upstream rules, supports multiple output formats, provides over 215,000 blocking rules and 102,000 DNS blocking rules, offers domestic accelerated subscriptions, and updates regularly to ensure effective ad blocking.

metadata.name: TikTokDownloader
metadata.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具

summary.zh: Python开发的抖音/TikTok内容下载与数据采集工具，支持视频、图集、直播内容批量下载，账号/搜索/热榜数据采集，提供终端交互、Web API两种使用模式，支持多线程、断点续传、多格式数据持久化与Docker部署，当前部分功能因加密参数失效待6.0版本重构修复。
summary.en: A Python-based Douyin/TikTok content downloader and data collection tool that supports batch download of videos, image sets and live streams, as well as data collection from accounts, search results and hot lists. It offers terminal interactive and Web API modes, with features including multi-threading, breakpoint resumption, multi-format data persistence and Docker deployment. Some functions are currently unavailable due to expired encryption parameters and will be fixed in the upcoming 6.0 version.

metadata.name: adblockfilters
metadata.description: 去广告合并规则，每8个小时更新一次。

summary.zh: 该项目为自动化广告过滤规则合并工具，每8小时自动同步上游多源广告拦截规则，经合并去重、DNS解析校验剔除无效域名后生成多版本规则库，提供多平台加速订阅链接，适配AdGuard、DNSMasq等主流工具，降低用户多设备配置成本。
summary.en: This project is an automated ad-blocking filter merging tool that synchronizes upstream multi-source ad-blocking rules every 8 hours. It generates multi-version rule libraries after deduplication and DNS verification to remove invalid domains, provides multi-platform accelerated subscription links, and is compatible with mainstream tools like AdGuard and DNSMasq, reducing users' multi-device configuration cost.

metadata.name: x-ui-yg
metadata.description: x-ui精简修改版脚本，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp传输协议、ENC加密、MLDSA65加密，集成argo固定临时双隧道（可共存）、Psiphon赛风VPN（30个国家）分流功能，支持部分节点聚合订阅、sing-box订阅、clash-meta订阅的配置输出

summary.zh: x-ui精简修改版一键部署脚本，适用于VPS代理服务快速搭建场景，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp等新型传输协议，集成Argo固定/临时双隧道与Psiphon赛风VPN分流，可本地生成多格式代理订阅，支持多架构多系统及Docker部署，无需依赖第三方外链保障订阅隐私。
summary.en: A streamlined modified one-click deployment script for x-ui proxy panel, designed for fast proxy service deployment on VPS, supporting next-gen transport protocols including Hysteria2 and Xhttp, integrating fixed and temporary dual Argo tunnels and Psiphon VPN traffic splitting, supporting local generation of multi-format proxy subscriptions, compatible with multi-architecture, multi-OS and Docker deployment, with no third-party external link dependency to ensure subscription privacy.

metadata.name: mediago
metadata.description: Cross-platform video downloader — sniff and grab m3u8/HLS streams, Bilibili, YouTube and more. Desktop + Docker + 🦞.
