summary.zh: MediaGo是跨平台视频下载工具，内置流量嗅探能力，无需抓包或配置浏览器扩展即可下载m3u8/HLS流，支持B站、YouTube等超过1000个主流站点，提供桌面端、Docker部署、内置格式转换、HTTP API及AI助手集成，适配个人下载、自动化集成等多场景。
summary.en: MediaGo is a cross-platform video downloader with built-in traffic sniffing, enabling m3u8/HLS stream downloading without packet capture or browser extension configuration. It supports over 1000 mainstream sites including Bilibili and YouTube, offers desktop and Docker deployment, built-in format conversion, HTTP API and AI assistant integration, suitable for personal downloading and automation integration scenarios.

metadata.name: biliup
metadata.description: 自动直播录制、投稿、twitch、ytb频道搬运工具。命令行投稿(B站)和视频下载工具，提供多种登录方式，支持多p。

summary.zh: biliup 是开源免费的直播录制、跨平台视频搬运与 B 站投稿工具，支持 19 个直播平台录制及弹幕抓取，提供多账号管理、24 小时无人值守、WebUI/命令行双操作模式，还可集成 AI Agent 实现自动化内容发布，适用于个人内容存档、跨平台搬运等场景。
summary.en: biliup is an open-source, free tool for live stream recording, cross-platform video migration and Bilibili upload. It supports recording and danmaku capture for 19 live platforms, offers multi-account management, 24/7 unattended operation, dual modes of WebUI and CLI, and can be integrated with AI Agents for automated content publishing, suitable for personal content archiving and cross-platform migration.

metadata.name: lx-music-sync-server
metadata.description: 运行在 Node.js 上的 LX Music 数据同步服务

summary.zh: 本项目是LX Music的独立数据同步服务端，基于Node.js开发，用于跨设备同步音乐收藏列表，支持私有化部署，需配合Nginx实现HTTPS反向代理，提供数据快照备份恢复能力，解决官方同步服务的可用性限制。
summary.en: This is an independent data sync server for LX Music, built on Node.js, used for cross-device synchronization of music favorite lists. It supports private deployment, requires Nginx for HTTPS reverse proxy, and provides data snapshot backup and recovery capabilities, solving the availability limitations of the official sync service.

metadata.name: 1Panel
metadata.description: 🔥 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform.

summary.zh: 1Panel是开源Linux服务器管理面板与轻量AI管理平台，通过可视化Web界面提供服务器监控、文件/数据库/容器管理、一键网站部署、AI Agent与模型统一管控、开源应用一键安装等能力，覆盖运维、建站、AI托管等多场景，大幅降低服务器管理门槛，全球用户超250万。
summary.en: 1Panel is an open-source Linux server management panel and lightweight AI management platform, trusted by 2.5M+ global self-hosters. It delivers comprehensive capabilities including server monitoring, file/database/container management, one-click website deployment, unified AI agent & model governance, and a built-in app store for one-click open-source app installation, all via an intuitive web GUI, serving scenarios like server operations, website building and AI hosting, greatly lowering server management barriers.

metadata.name: anti-AD
metadata.description: 致力于成为中文区命中率最高的广告过滤列表，实现精确的广告屏蔽和隐私保护。anti-AD 现已支持 AdGuardHome，dnsmasq，Surge，Pi-Hole，Clash, mihomo，smartdns，sing-box 等网络组件。完全兼容常见的广告过滤工具所支持的各种广告过滤列表格式

summary.zh: 面向中文用户的高命中率广告过滤与隐私保护工具，基于DNS解析层实现，支持AdGuardHome、dnsmasq、Surge等十余种主流网络组件，兼容各类广告过滤列表格式，可屏蔽广告域名、设备内置广告及隐私收集站点，通过合并去重上游规则、优化匹配逻辑、剔除失效域名生成高精度过滤列表。
summary.en: A high-precision ad blocking and privacy protection tool tailored for Chinese users, operating at the DNS resolution layer. It supports 10+ mainstream network components including AdGuardHome, dnsmasq, Surge and Pi-Hole, is compatible with all common ad filter list formats, and can block ad domains, built-in app ads and privacy-tracking sites. The list is generated by merging and deduplicating upstream rules, optimizing matching logic and removing invalid domains.

metadata.name: SmartTube
metadata.description: Browse media content with your own rules on Android TV

summary.zh: SmartTube 是一款免费开源的 Android TV/电视盒媒体客户端，可作为官方 YouTube TV 的替代方案。它集成 SponsorBlock 去广告，支持 8K/HDR/60fps 播放，无需谷歌服务即可运行，兼容低至安卓 4.3 的老旧设备，通过官方渠道直接分发安装。
summary.en: SmartTube is a free open-source media client for Android TV and TV boxes, serving as an alternative to the official YouTube TV. It integrates SponsorBlock for ad skipping, supports 8K/HDR/60fps playback, runs without Google Services, is compatible with devices as old as Android 4.3, and is distributed via official channels for direct installation.

summary.zh: downkyi 是一款哔哩哔哩视频下载工具，支持下载高清视频、弹幕、字幕等内容，因被指控逆向破解B站非公开接口、绕过反爬风控与付费内容保护机制，收到平台委托律所律师函后已停止维护并永久关停。
summary.en: downkyi is a Bilibili video downloader that supports downloading high-definition videos, bullet comments, subtitles and other content. It has ceased maintenance and been permanently closed after receiving a lawyer's letter from a law firm commissioned by Bilibili, which accused it of reverse-engineering Bilibili's non-public interfaces, bypassing anti-crawler risk control and paid content protection mechanisms.

metadata.name: changedetection.io
metadata.description: Best and simplest tool for website change detection, web page monitoring, and website change alerts. Perfect for tracking content changes, price drops, restock alerts, and website defacement monitoring—all for free or enjoy our SaaS plan!

summary.zh: changedetection.io 是开源网站变更检测工具，支持网页内容监控、价格波动追踪、补货提醒、网页篡改监测等场景，可对接Discord、邮件等多平台通知，新增AI大模型驱动的智能告警过滤与变更摘要能力，同时提供自托管与SaaS服务。
summary.en: changedetection.io is an open-source website change detection tool that supports webpage content monitoring, price fluctuation tracking, restock alerts, and website defacement monitoring. It integrates with multi-platform notification channels including Discord and Email, and features AI large model-powered intelligent alert filtering and change summary capabilities, with both self-hosted and SaaS services available.

metadata.name: free-api
metadata.description: 收集免费的接口服务,做一个api的搬运工

summary.zh: 该仓库为免费API聚合资源库，持续收集并每月更新涵盖工具、生活、AI、数据查询等多领域的免费公开接口，为开发者提供一站式免费接口调用资源，降低开发成本，多数接口支持在线直接调用。
summary.en: This repository is a free API aggregation resource library, which continuously collects and updates free public APIs covering multiple fields such as tools, daily life, AI and data query on a monthly basis. It provides developers with one-stop free API calling resources, reduces development costs, and most interfaces support direct online calling.

metadata.name: rsspush
metadata.description: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。

summary.zh: RSSPush 是开源的 RSS 监测推送 Web 应用，支持 Docker 一键部署，可监测 RSS 源变动并推送至微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十个消息通道，内置 RSSHub 源集成、关键词过滤、内容自动翻译等能力，适用于个人内容订阅聚合、团队信息同步通知场景。
summary.en: RSSPush is an open-source RSS monitoring and push web application that supports one-click Docker deployment, compatible with x86 and arm64 architectures. It can monitor RSS source changes in real time and push updates to dozens of messaging channels including WeChat, Telegram, Discord, Slack and more, with built-in RSSHub source integration, keyword blacklist/whitelist filtering and automatic content translation capabilities, suitable for personal content subscription aggregation and team information synchronization notification scenarios.

metadata.name: TrackersListCollection
metadata.description: 🎈 Updated daily! A list of popular BitTorrent Trackers! / 每天更新！全网热门 BT Tracker 列表！

summary.zh: 每日更新的热门BT Tracker合集仓库，由社区维护并收录经人工筛选的高可用Tracker地址，提供最优/全量/HTTP/无HTTP等多分类列表，支持多镜像下载及Aria2格式适配，可有效提升P2P资源下载速度，解决BT下载连接受限、速度慢的痛点，被全球BT爱好者广泛使用。
summary.en: A daily updated community-maintained repository of popular BitTorrent trackers for global users, offering hand-picked high-availability tracker addresses with multiple categorized lists (best, all, HTTP-only, no-HTTP, etc.), providing multi-mirror download links and Aria2-compatible format, widely used by BT enthusiasts worldwide to effectively boost P2P resource download speed and resolve slow download and connection issues of BitTorrent.

metadata.name: WebMonitor
metadata.description: 实时监控网页变化，并发送通知（Monitor web page changes in real time and send notifications）

summary.zh: WebMonitor 是一款开源的网页变化实时监控工具，支持 requests/PhantomJS 抓取网页，兼容 xpath、CSS 选择器、JsonPath 提取数据，可对接邮件、Telegram、微信等多渠道通知，提供可视化操作界面，支持自定义规则、RSS 监控与数据导入导出，适用于内容更新、信息变动等场景的监测提醒。
summary.en: WebMonitor is an open-source real-time web page change monitoring tool that supports requests/PhantomJS for web scraping, compatible with xpath, CSS selectors and JsonPath for data extraction. It integrates multi-channel notifications such as email, Telegram and WeChat, provides a visual UI, and supports custom rules, RSS monitoring and data import/export, suitable for alert scenarios of content updates and information changes.

metadata.name: FileCentipede
metadata.description: Cross-platform internet upload/download manager for HTTP(S), FTP(S), SSH, magnet-link, BitTorrent, m3u8, ed2k, and online videos.  WebDAV client, FTP client, SSH client.

summary.zh: FileCentipede是全能跨平台文件上传下载管理工具，支持HTTP(S)、FTP(S)、SSH、磁力链接、BitTorrent、m3u8等多类协议，集成WebDAV/FTP/SSH客户端与浏览器插件，可下载在线加密视频，还提供HTTP请求、文件合并等辅助工具，功能全面且易用。
summary.en: FileCentipede is an all-in-one cross-platform file upload/download manager supporting HTTP(S), FTP(S), SSH, magnet links, BitTorrent, m3u8 and other protocols. It integrates WebDAV, FTP, SSH clients and browser extensions, can download encrypted online videos, and provides auxiliary tools like HTTP requester and file merger, with comprehensive functions and high usability.

metadata.name: Docker_Microsoft365_E5_Renew_X
metadata.description: Docker版本的E5调用API续订服务：Microsoft 365 E5 Renew X

summary.zh: 本项目是Microsoft 365 E5订阅续订服务的Docker封装版本，基于开源E5 Renew X改造，镜像仅225M，支持多CPU架构适配，部署仅需单行命令，内置邮件通知、Web管理界面，支持数据卷挂载实现配置备份迁移，仅用于Docker学习用途，禁止商业化。
summary.en: This project is a Docker-packaged version of the Microsoft 365 E5 subscription renewal service, modified from the open-source E5 Renew X. It features a compact 225MB image, supports multiple CPU architectures, and can be deployed with a single command. Built-in functions include email notification, a web management interface, and data volume mounting for configuration backup and migration. It is exclusively for Docker learning use, and commercial use is prohibited.

metadata.name: v2ray-heroku
metadata.description: 用于在 Heroku 上部署 V2Ray WebSocket。

summary.zh: 本仓库提供Heroku平台一键部署V2Ray WebSocket代理服务的自动化方案，支持自动更新V2Ray版本、自定义UUID与WebSocket路径，合理使用不会触发平台封号，可对接Cloudflare提升访问速度，适用于个人代理服务快速搭建场景，部署流程简单。
summary.en: This repository offers a one-click automated deployment solution for V2Ray WebSocket proxy services on the Heroku platform. It supports automatic V2Ray version updates, customizable UUID and WebSocket paths, and avoids platform bans under reasonable usage. It can be integrated with Cloudflare to boost access speed, making it ideal for rapid personal proxy service deployment with simple operation.

metadata.name: ContextMenuManager
metadata.description: 🖱️ 纯粹的Windows右键菜单管理程序

summary.zh: ContextMenuManager 是一款开源的 Windows 右键菜单管理桌面工具，基于 .NET 开发，支持 Win7 至 Win10 全系列系统，可对文件、文件夹、WinX 等各类右键菜单项实现启用/禁用、重命名、增删、定位注册表/文件位置等操作，采用系统原生键值隐藏菜单而非暴力删除，兼容高低分屏与多语言，完全免费。
summary.en: ContextMenuManager is an open-source Windows right-click menu management desktop tool built on .NET, compatible with Windows 7 to 10 systems. It supports enabling/disabling, renaming, adding/deleting right-click menu items for files, folders, WinX and other scenarios, locates related registry and file paths, and hides menus via system native keys instead of aggressive deletion. It also supports high-DPI screens and multi-language, and is completely free.

metadata.name: lx-music-desktop
metadata.description: 一个基于 Electron 的音乐软件

summary.zh: 基于 Electron 与 Vue 3 开发的跨平台桌面音乐播放器，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 三大系统，提供多源音乐播放、本地数据同步、开放 API 调用、Scheme URL 联动浏览器等能力，适配个人桌面音乐使用场景。
summary.en: A cross-platform desktop music player developed with Electron and Vue 3, supporting Windows, macOS and Linux systems. It provides multi-source music playback, local data synchronization, open API access, Scheme URL integration with browsers, and other capabilities, suitable for personal desktop music usage scenarios.

metadata.name: ShareX
metadata.description: ShareX is a free and open-source application that enables users to capture or record any area of their screen with a single keystroke. It also supports uploading images, text, and various file types to a wide range of destinations.

summary.zh: ShareX是免费开源的Windows桌面效率工具，集成屏幕截图、录屏、OCR识别、文件上传共享及自动化工作流能力，无广告且隐私友好，面向开发者、内容创作者等群体，支持自定义热键与上传目标，可大幅提升日常截图、文件分享的效率。
summary.en: ShareX is a free, open-source Windows desktop productivity tool that integrates screen capture, screen recording, OCR recognition, file upload/sharing and automated workflow features. Ad-free and privacy-focused, it caters to developers, content creators and other users, supports custom hotkeys and upload destinations, greatly improving the efficiency of daily screenshot and file sharing tasks.

metadata.name: ChromeAppHeroes
metadata.description: 🌈谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜, 为优秀的Chrome插件写一本中文说明书, 让Chrome插件英雄们造福人类~  ChromePluginHeroes, Write a Chinese manual for the excellent Chrome plugin, let the Chrome plugin heroes benefit the human~ 公众号「0加1」同步更新

summary.zh: 《谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜》是开源中文Chrome插件指南项目，基于docsify构建并托管于GitHub Pages，系统整理优质Chrome插件的使用教程，覆盖翻译、去广告、学习、效率工具等多场景，降低用户优质插件使用门槛，同步公众号更新。
summary.en: ChromeAppHeroes is an open-source Chinese guide project for Chrome extensions, built with docsify and hosted on GitHub Pages. It compiles usage tutorials for high-quality Chrome plugins, covering scenarios like translation, ad blocking, learning and productivity tools, lowering the barrier for users to access excellent extensions, with updates synchronized to its official account.

metadata.name: v2rayN
metadata.description: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others

summary.zh: v2rayN是支持Windows、Linux、macOS的跨平台桌面代理客户端GUI工具，兼容Xray、sing-box等多款主流代理核心，覆盖x64、arm64等多CPU架构，提供GPG签名校验保障文件安全，是面向普通用户的网络代理访问工具。
summary.en: v2rayN is a cross-platform desktop GUI proxy client supporting Windows, Linux and macOS, compatible with mainstream proxy cores such as Xray and sing-box, covering multiple CPU architectures like x64 and arm64, with GPG signature verification to ensure file security, serving as a user-friendly network proxy access tool.
